methods.name: move_and_slide
methods.description:
Moves the body based on [member velocity]. If the body collides with another, it will slide along the other body rather than stop immediately. If the other body is a [CharacterBody3D] or [RigidBody3D], it will also be affected by the motion of the other body. You can use this to make moving and rotating platforms, or to make nodes push other nodes.
This method should be used in [method Node._physics_process] (or in a method called by [method Node._physics_process]), as it uses the physics step's [code]delta[/code] value automatically in calculations. Otherwise, the simulation will run at an incorrect speed.
Modifies [member velocity] if a slide collision occurred. To get the latest collision call [method get_last_slide_collision], for more detailed information about collisions that occurred, use [method get_slide_collision].
When the body touches a moving platform, the platform's velocity is automatically added to the body motion. If a collision occurs due to the platform's motion, it will always be first in the slide collisions.
Returns [code]true[/code] if the body collided, otherwise, returns [code]false[/code].

classes.name: CheckBox
classes.brief_description: A button that represents a binary choice.
classes.description:
[CheckBox] allows the user to choose one of only two possible options. It's similar to [CheckButton] in functionality, but it has a different appearance. To follow established UX patterns, it's recommended to use [CheckBox] when toggling it has [b]no[/b] immediate effect on something. For example, it could be used when toggling it will only do something once a confirmation button is pressed.
See also [BaseButton] which contains common properties and methods associated with this node.
When [member BaseButton.button_group] specifies a [ButtonGroup], [CheckBox] changes its appearance to that of a radio button and uses the various [code]radio_*[/code] theme properties.

classes.name: CheckButton
classes.brief_description: A button that represents a binary choice.
classes.description:
[CheckButton] is a toggle button displayed as a check field. It's similar to [CheckBox] in functionality, but it has a different appearance. To follow established UX patterns, it's recommended to use [CheckButton] when toggling it has an [b]immediate[/b] effect on something. For example, it can be used when pressing it shows or hides advanced settings, without asking the user to confirm this action.
See also [BaseButton] which contains common properties and methods associated with this node.

values.name: LOCATION_PARENT_MASK
values.description: The option is from the containing class or a parent class, relative to the location of the code completion query. Perform a bitwise OR with the class depth (e.g. [code]0[/code] for the local class, [code]1[/code] for the parent, [code]2[/code] for the grandparent, etc.) to store the depth of an option in the class or a parent class.

values.name: LOCATION_OTHER_USER_CODE
values.description: The option is from user code which is not local and not in a derived class (e.g. Autoload Singletons).

values.name: LOCATION_OTHER
values.description: The option is from other engine code, not covered by the other enum constants - e.g. built-in classes.

methods.name: _confirm_code_completion
methods.description: Override this method to define how the selected entry should be inserted. If [param replace] is [code]true[/code], any existing text should be replaced.

methods.name: _request_code_completion
methods.description: Override this method to define what happens when the user requests code completion. If [param force] is [code]true[/code], any checks should be bypassed.

methods.name: _filter_code_completion_candidates
methods.description:
Override this method to define what items in [param candidates] should be displayed.
Both [param candidates] and the return is an [Array] of [Dictionary], see [method get_code_completion_option] for [Dictionary] content.

methods.name: do_indent
methods.description: If there is no selection, indentation is inserted at the caret. Otherwise, the selected lines are indented like [method indent_lines]. Equivalent to the [member ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_indent] action. The indentation characters used depend on [member indent_use_spaces] and [member indent_size].

methods.name: indent_lines
methods.description: Indents all lines that are selected or have a caret on them. Uses spaces or a tab depending on [member indent_use_spaces]. See [method unindent_lines].

methods.name: unindent_lines
methods.description: Unindents all lines that are selected or have a caret on them. Uses spaces or a tab depending on [member indent_use_spaces]. Equivalent to the [member ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_dedent] action. See [method indent_lines].

methods.name: convert_indent
methods.description:
Converts the indents of lines between [param from_line] and [param to_line] to tabs or spaces as set by [member indent_use_spaces].
Values of [code]-1[/code] convert the entire text.

methods.name: add_auto_brace_completion_pair
methods.description:
Adds a brace pair.
Both the start and end keys must be symbols. Only the start key has to be unique.

methods.name: has_auto_brace_completion_open_key
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if open key [param open_key] exists.

methods.name: has_auto_brace_completion_close_key
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if close key [param close_key] exists.

methods.name: get_auto_brace_completion_close_key
methods.description: Gets the matching auto brace close key for [param open_key].

methods.name: set_line_as_breakpoint
methods.description: Sets the given line as a breakpoint. If [code]true[/code] and [member gutters_draw_breakpoints_gutter] is [code]true[/code], draws the [theme_item breakpoint] icon in the gutter for this line. See [method get_breakpointed_lines] and [method is_line_breakpointed].

methods.name: is_line_breakpointed
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given line is breakpointed. See [method set_line_as_breakpoint].

methods.name: clear_breakpointed_lines
methods.description: Clears all breakpointed lines.

methods.name: get_breakpointed_lines
methods.description: Gets all breakpointed lines.

methods.name: set_line_as_bookmarked
methods.description: Sets the given line as bookmarked. If [code]true[/code] and [member gutters_draw_bookmarks] is [code]true[/code], draws the [theme_item bookmark] icon in the gutter for this line. See [method get_bookmarked_lines] and [method is_line_bookmarked].

methods.name: is_line_bookmarked
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given line is bookmarked. See [method set_line_as_bookmarked].

methods.name: clear_bookmarked_lines
methods.description: Clears all bookmarked lines.

methods.name: get_bookmarked_lines
methods.description: Gets all bookmarked lines.

methods.name: set_line_as_executing
methods.description: Sets the given line as executing. If [code]true[/code] and [member gutters_draw_executing_lines] is [code]true[/code], draws the [theme_item executing_line] icon in the gutter for this line. See [method get_executing_lines] and [method is_line_executing].

methods.name: is_line_executing
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given line is marked as executing. See [method set_line_as_executing].

methods.name: clear_executing_lines
methods.description: Clears all executed lines.

methods.name: get_executing_lines
methods.description: Gets all executing lines.

methods.name: can_fold_line
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given line is foldable. A line is foldable if it is the start of a valid code region (see [method get_code_region_start_tag]), if it is the start of a comment or string block, or if the next non-empty line is more indented (see [method TextEdit.get_indent_level]).

methods.name: fold_line
methods.description: Folds the given line, if possible (see [method can_fold_line]).

methods.name: unfold_line
methods.description: Unfolds the given line if it is folded or if it is hidden under a folded line.

methods.name: fold_all_lines
methods.description: Folds all lines that are possible to be folded (see [method can_fold_line]).

methods.name: unfold_all_lines
methods.description: Unfolds all lines that are folded.

methods.name: toggle_foldable_line
methods.description: Toggle the folding of the code block at the given line.

methods.name: toggle_foldable_lines_at_carets
methods.description: Toggle the folding of the code block on all lines with a caret on them.

methods.name: is_line_folded
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given line is folded. See [method fold_line].

methods.name: get_folded_lines
methods.description: Returns all lines that are currently folded.

methods.name: create_code_region
methods.description:
Creates a new code region with the selection. At least one single line comment delimiter have to be defined (see [method add_comment_delimiter]).
A code region is a part of code that is highlighted when folded and can help organize your script.
Code region start and end tags can be customized (see [method set_code_region_tags]).
Code regions are delimited using start and end tags (respectively [code]region[/code] and [code]endregion[/code] by default) preceded by one line comment delimiter. (eg. [code]#region[/code] and [code]#endregion[/code])

methods.name: get_code_region_start_tag
methods.description: Returns the code region start tag (without comment delimiter).

methods.name: get_code_region_end_tag
methods.description: Returns the code region end tag (without comment delimiter).

methods.name: set_code_region_tags
methods.description: Sets the code region start and end tags (without comment delimiter).

methods.name: is_line_code_region_start
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given line is a code region start. See [method set_code_region_tags].

methods.name: is_line_code_region_end
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given line is a code region end. See [method set_code_region_tags].

methods.name: add_string_delimiter
methods.description:
Defines a string delimiter from [param start_key] to [param end_key]. Both keys should be symbols, and [param start_key] must not be shared with other delimiters.
If [param line_only] is [code]true[/code] or [param end_key] is an empty [String], the region does not carry over to the next line.

methods.name: remove_string_delimiter
methods.description: Removes the string delimiter with [param start_key].

methods.name: has_string_delimiter
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if string [param start_key] exists.

methods.name: clear_string_delimiters
methods.description: Removes all string delimiters.

methods.name: is_in_string
methods.description: Returns the delimiter index if [param line] [param column] is in a string. If [param column] is not provided, will return the delimiter index if the entire [param line] is a string. Otherwise [code]-1[/code].

methods.name: add_comment_delimiter
methods.description:
Adds a comment delimiter from [param start_key] to [param end_key]. Both keys should be symbols, and [param start_key] must not be shared with other delimiters.
If [param line_only] is [code]true[/code] or [param end_key] is an empty [String], the region does not carry over to the next line.

methods.name: remove_comment_delimiter
methods.description: Removes the comment delimiter with [param start_key].

methods.name: has_comment_delimiter
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if comment [param start_key] exists.

methods.name: clear_comment_delimiters
methods.description: Removes all comment delimiters.

methods.name: is_in_comment
methods.description: Returns delimiter index if [param line] [param column] is in a comment. If [param column] is not provided, will return delimiter index if the entire [param line] is a comment. Otherwise [code]-1[/code].

methods.name: get_delimiter_start_key
methods.description: Gets the start key for a string or comment region index.

methods.name: get_delimiter_end_key
methods.description: Gets the end key for a string or comment region index.

methods.name: get_delimiter_start_position
methods.description: If [param line] [param column] is in a string or comment, returns the start position of the region. If not or no start could be found, both [Vector2] values will be [code]-1[/code].

methods.name: get_delimiter_end_position
methods.description: If [param line] [param column] is in a string or comment, returns the end position of the region. If not or no end could be found, both [Vector2] values will be [code]-1[/code].

methods.name: set_code_hint
methods.description: Sets the code hint text. Pass an empty string to clear.

methods.name: set_code_hint_draw_below
methods.description: If [code]true[/code], the code hint will draw below the main caret. If [code]false[/code], the code hint will draw above the main caret. See [method set_code_hint].

methods.name: get_text_for_code_completion
methods.description: Returns the full text with char [code]0xFFFF[/code] at the caret location.

methods.name: request_code_completion
methods.description: Emits [signal code_completion_requested], if [param force] is [code]true[/code] will bypass all checks. Otherwise will check that the caret is in a word or in front of a prefix. Will ignore the request if all current options are of type file path, node path, or signal.

methods.name: add_code_completion_option
methods.description:
Submits an item to the queue of potential candidates for the autocomplete menu. Call [method update_code_completion_options] to update the list.
[param location] indicates location of the option relative to the location of the code completion query. See [enum CodeEdit.CodeCompletionLocation] for how to set this value.
[b]Note:[/b] This list will replace all current candidates.

methods.name: update_code_completion_options
methods.description:
Submits all completion options added with [method add_code_completion_option]. Will try to force the autocomplete menu to popup, if [param force] is [code]true[/code].
[b]Note:[/b] This will replace all current candidates.

methods.name: get_code_completion_options
methods.description: Gets all completion options, see [method get_code_completion_option] for return content.

methods.name: get_code_completion_option
methods.description:
Gets the completion option at [param index]. The return [Dictionary] has the following key-values:
[code]kind[/code]: [enum CodeCompletionKind]
[code]display_text[/code]: Text that is shown on the autocomplete menu.
[code]insert_text[/code]: Text that is to be inserted when this item is selected.
[code]font_color[/code]: Color of the text on the autocomplete menu.
[code]icon[/code]: Icon to draw on the autocomplete menu.
[code]default_value[/code]: Value of the symbol.

methods.name: get_code_completion_selected_index
methods.description: Gets the index of the current selected completion option.

methods.name: set_code_completion_selected_index
methods.description: Sets the current selected completion option.

methods.name: confirm_code_completion
methods.description: Inserts the selected entry into the text. If [param replace] is [code]true[/code], any existing text is replaced rather than merged.

methods.name: cancel_code_completion
methods.description: Cancels the autocomplete menu.

methods.name: get_text_for_symbol_lookup
methods.description: Returns the full text with char [code]0xFFFF[/code] at the cursor location.

methods.name: get_text_with_cursor_char
methods.description: Returns the full text with char [code]0xFFFF[/code] at the specified location.

methods.name: set_symbol_lookup_word_as_valid
methods.description: Sets the symbol emitted by [signal symbol_validate] as a valid lookup.

methods.name: move_lines_up
methods.description: Moves all lines up that are selected or have a caret on them.

methods.name: move_lines_down
methods.description: Moves all lines down that are selected or have a caret on them.

methods.name: delete_lines
methods.description: Deletes all lines that are selected or have a caret on them.

methods.name: join_lines
methods.description: Joins all selected lines or lines containing a caret with their next line. Whitespace in between will be removed. If the next line has content, the [param line_ending] will be inserted in between.

methods.name: duplicate_selection
methods.description: Duplicates all selected text and duplicates all lines with a caret on them.

methods.name: duplicate_lines
methods.description: Duplicates all lines currently selected with any caret. Duplicates the entire line beneath the current one no matter where the caret is within the line.

signals.name: breakpoint_toggled
signals.description: Emitted when a breakpoint is added or removed from a line. If the line is removed via backspace, a signal is emitted at the old line.

signals.name: code_completion_requested
signals.description: Emitted when the user requests code completion. This signal will not be sent if [method _request_code_completion] is overridden or [member code_completion_enabled] is [code]false[/code].

signals.name: symbol_lookup
signals.description: Emitted when the user has clicked on a valid symbol.

signals.name: symbol_validate
signals.description:
Emitted when the user hovers over a symbol. The symbol should be validated and responded to, by calling [method set_symbol_lookup_word_as_valid].
[b]Note:[/b] [member symbol_lookup_on_click] must be [code]true[/code] for this signal to be emitted.

signals.name: symbol_hovered
signals.description:
Emitted when the user hovers over a symbol. Unlike [signal Control.mouse_entered], this signal is not emitted immediately, but when the cursor is over the symbol for [member ProjectSettings.gui/timers/tooltip_delay_sec] seconds.
[b]Note:[/b] [member symbol_tooltip_on_hover] must be [code]true[/code] for this signal to be emitted.

properties.name: symbol_lookup_on_click
properties.description: Set when a validated word from [signal symbol_validate] is clicked, the [signal symbol_lookup] should be emitted.

properties.name: symbol_tooltip_on_hover
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the [signal symbol_hovered] signal is emitted when hovering over a word.

properties.name: line_folding
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], lines can be folded. Otherwise, line folding methods like [method fold_line] will not work and [method can_fold_line] will always return [code]false[/code]. See [member gutters_draw_fold_gutter].

properties.name: line_length_guidelines
properties.description: Draws vertical lines at the provided columns. The first entry is considered a main hard guideline and is drawn more prominently.

properties.name: gutters_draw_breakpoints_gutter
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], breakpoints are drawn in the gutter. This gutter is shared with bookmarks and executing lines. Clicking the gutter will toggle the breakpoint for the line, see [method set_line_as_breakpoint].

properties.name: gutters_draw_bookmarks
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], bookmarks are drawn in the gutter. This gutter is shared with breakpoints and executing lines. See [method set_line_as_bookmarked].

properties.name: gutters_draw_executing_lines
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], executing lines are marked in the gutter. This gutter is shared with breakpoints and bookmarks. See [method set_line_as_executing].

properties.name: gutters_draw_line_numbers
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the line number gutter is drawn. Line numbers start at [code]1[/code] and are incremented for each line of text. Clicking and dragging in the line number gutter will select entire lines of text.

properties.name: gutters_zero_pad_line_numbers
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], line numbers drawn in the gutter are zero padded based on the total line count. Requires [member gutters_draw_line_numbers] to be set to [code]true[/code].

properties.name: gutters_line_numbers_min_digits
properties.description: The minimum width in digits reserved for the line number gutter.

properties.name: gutters_draw_fold_gutter
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the fold gutter is drawn. In this gutter, the [theme_item can_fold_code_region] icon is drawn for each foldable line (see [method can_fold_line]) and the [theme_item folded_code_region] icon is drawn for each folded line (see [method is_line_folded]). These icons can be clicked to toggle the fold state, see [method toggle_foldable_line]. [member line_folding] must be [code]true[/code] to show icons.

properties.name: delimiter_strings
properties.description: Sets the string delimiters. All existing string delimiters will be removed.

properties.name: delimiter_comments
properties.description: Sets the comment delimiters. All existing comment delimiters will be removed.

properties.name: code_completion_enabled
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the [member ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_completion_query] action requests code completion. To handle it, see [method _request_code_completion] or [signal code_completion_requested].

properties.name: code_completion_prefixes
properties.description: Sets prefixes that will trigger code completion.

properties.name: indent_size
properties.description: Size of the tabulation indent (one [kbd]Tab[/kbd] press) in characters. If [member indent_use_spaces] is enabled the number of spaces to use.

properties.name: indent_use_spaces
properties.description: Use spaces instead of tabs for indentation.

properties.name: indent_automatic
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], an extra indent is automatically inserted when a new line is added and a prefix in [member indent_automatic_prefixes] is found. If a brace pair opening key is found, the matching closing brace will be moved to another new line (see [member auto_brace_completion_pairs]).

properties.name: indent_automatic_prefixes
properties.description: Prefixes to trigger an automatic indent. Used when [member indent_automatic] is set to [code]true[/code].

properties.name: auto_brace_completion_enabled
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], uses [member auto_brace_completion_pairs] to automatically insert the closing brace when the opening brace is inserted by typing or autocompletion. Also automatically removes the closing brace when using backspace on the opening brace.

properties.name: auto_brace_completion_highlight_matching
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], highlights brace pairs when the caret is on either one, using [member auto_brace_completion_pairs]. If matching, the pairs will be underlined. If a brace is unmatched, it is colored with [theme_item brace_mismatch_color].

properties.name: auto_brace_completion_pairs
properties.description: Sets the brace pairs to be autocompleted. For each entry in the dictionary, the key is the opening brace and the value is the closing brace that matches it. A brace is a [String] made of symbols. See [member auto_brace_completion_enabled] and [member auto_brace_completion_highlight_matching].

classes.brief_description: A multiline text editor designed for editing code.
classes.description:
CodeEdit is a specialized [TextEdit] designed for editing plain text code files. It has many features commonly found in code editors such as line numbers, line folding, code completion, indent management, and string/comment management.
[b]Note:[/b] Regardless of locale, [CodeEdit] will by default always use left-to-right text direction to correctly display source code.

classes.name: CodeHighlighter

methods.name: add_keyword_color
methods.description:
Sets the color for a keyword.
The keyword cannot contain any symbols except '_'.

methods.name: remove_keyword_color
methods.description: Removes the keyword.

methods.name: has_keyword_color
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the keyword exists, else [code]false[/code].

methods.name: get_keyword_color
methods.description: Returns the color for a keyword.

methods.name: clear_keyword_colors
methods.description: Removes all keywords.

methods.name: add_member_keyword_color
methods.description:
Sets the color for a member keyword.
The member keyword cannot contain any symbols except '_'.
It will not be highlighted if preceded by a '.'.

methods.name: remove_member_keyword_color
methods.description: Removes the member keyword.

methods.name: has_member_keyword_color
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the member keyword exists, else [code]false[/code].

methods.name: get_member_keyword_color
methods.description: Returns the color for a member keyword.

methods.name: clear_member_keyword_colors
methods.description: Removes all member keywords.

methods.name: add_color_region
methods.description:
Adds a color region (such as for comments or strings) from [param start_key] to [param end_key]. Both keys should be symbols, and [param start_key] must not be shared with other delimiters.
If [param line_only] is [code]true[/code] or [param end_key] is an empty [String], the region does not carry over to the next line.

methods.name: remove_color_region
methods.description: Removes the color region that uses that start key.

methods.name: has_color_region
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the start key exists, else [code]false[/code].

methods.name: clear_color_regions
methods.description: Removes all color regions.

properties.name: number_color
properties.description: Sets the color for numbers.

properties.name: symbol_color
properties.description: Sets the color for symbols.

properties.name: function_color
properties.description: Sets color for functions. A function is a non-keyword string followed by a '('.

properties.name: member_variable_color
properties.description: Sets color for member variables. A member variable is non-keyword, non-function string proceeded with a '.'.

properties.name: keyword_colors
properties.description: Sets the keyword colors. All existing keywords will be removed. The [Dictionary] key is the keyword. The value is the keyword color.

properties.name: member_keyword_colors
properties.description: Sets the member keyword colors. All existing member keyword will be removed. The [Dictionary] key is the member keyword. The value is the member keyword color.

properties.name: color_regions
properties.description: Sets the color regions. All existing regions will be removed. The [Dictionary] key is the region start and end key, separated by a space. The value is the region color.

classes.brief_description: A syntax highlighter intended for code.
classes.description: By adjusting various properties of this resource, you can change the colors of strings, comments, numbers, and other text patterns inside a [TextEdit] control.

classes.name: CollisionObject2D

values.name: DISABLE_MODE_REMOVE
values.description:
When [member Node.process_mode] is set to [constant Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED], remove from the physics simulation to stop all physics interactions with this [CollisionObject2D].
Automatically re-added to the physics simulation when the [Node] is processed again.

values.name: DISABLE_MODE_MAKE_STATIC
values.description:
When [member Node.process_mode] is set to [constant Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED], make the body static. Doesn't affect [Area2D]. [PhysicsBody2D] can't be affected by forces or other bodies while static.
Automatically set [PhysicsBody2D] back to its original mode when the [Node] is processed again.

values.name: DISABLE_MODE_KEEP_ACTIVE
values.description: When [member Node.process_mode] is set to [constant Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED], do not affect the physics simulation.

methods.name: _input_event
methods.description:
Accepts unhandled [InputEvent]s. [param shape_idx] is the child index of the clicked [Shape2D]. Connect to [signal input_event] to easily pick up these events.
[b]Note:[/b] [method _input_event] requires [member input_pickable] to be [code]true[/code] and at least one [member collision_layer] bit to be set.

methods.name: _mouse_enter
methods.description: Called when the mouse pointer enters any of this object's shapes. Requires [member input_pickable] to be [code]true[/code] and at least one [member collision_layer] bit to be set. Note that moving between different shapes within a single [CollisionObject2D] won't cause this function to be called.

methods.name: _mouse_exit
methods.description: Called when the mouse pointer exits all this object's shapes. Requires [member input_pickable] to be [code]true[/code] and at least one [member collision_layer] bit to be set. Note that moving between different shapes within a single [CollisionObject2D] won't cause this function to be called.

methods.name: _mouse_shape_enter
methods.description: Called when the mouse pointer enters any of this object's shapes or moves from one shape to another. [param shape_idx] is the child index of the newly entered [Shape2D]. Requires [member input_pickable] to be [code]true[/code] and at least one [member collision_layer] bit to be called.

methods.name: _mouse_shape_exit
methods.description: Called when the mouse pointer exits any of this object's shapes. [param shape_idx] is the child index of the exited [Shape2D]. Requires [member input_pickable] to be [code]true[/code] and at least one [member collision_layer] bit to be called.

methods.name: get_rid
methods.description: Returns the object's [RID].

methods.name: set_collision_layer_value
methods.description: Based on [param value], enables or disables the specified layer in the [member collision_layer], given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32.

methods.name: get_collision_layer_value
methods.description: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the [member collision_layer] is enabled, given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32.

methods.name: set_collision_mask_value
methods.description: Based on [param value], enables or disables the specified layer in the [member collision_mask], given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32.

methods.name: get_collision_mask_value
methods.description: Returns whether or not the specified layer of the [member collision_mask] is enabled, given a [param layer_number] between 1 and 32.

methods.name: create_shape_owner
methods.description: Creates a new shape owner for the given object. Returns [code]owner_id[/code] of the new owner for future reference.

methods.name: remove_shape_owner
methods.description: Removes the given shape owner.

methods.name: get_shape_owners
methods.description: Returns an [Array] of [code]owner_id[/code] identifiers. You can use these ids in other methods that take [code]owner_id[/code] as an argument.

methods.name: shape_owner_set_transform
methods.description: Sets the [Transform2D] of the given shape owner.

methods.name: shape_owner_get_transform
methods.description: Returns the shape owner's [Transform2D].

methods.name: shape_owner_get_owner
methods.description: Returns the parent object of the given shape owner.

methods.name: shape_owner_set_disabled
methods.description: If [code]true[/code], disables the given shape owner.

methods.name: is_shape_owner_disabled
methods.description: If [code]true[/code], the shape owner and its shapes are disabled.

methods.name: shape_owner_set_one_way_collision
methods.description: If [param enable] is [code]true[/code], collisions for the shape owner originating from this [CollisionObject2D] will not be reported to collided with [CollisionObject2D]s.

methods.name: is_shape_owner_one_way_collision_enabled
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if collisions for the shape owner originating from this [CollisionObject2D] will not be reported to collided with [CollisionObject2D]s.

methods.name: shape_owner_set_one_way_collision_margin
methods.description: Sets the [code]one_way_collision_margin[/code] of the shape owner identified by given [param owner_id] to [param margin] pixels.

methods.name: get_shape_owner_one_way_collision_margin
methods.description: Returns the [code]one_way_collision_margin[/code] of the shape owner identified by given [param owner_id].

methods.name: get_shape_owner_one_way_collision_direction
methods.description: Returns the [code]one_way_collision_direction[/code] of the shape owner identified by the given [param owner_id].

methods.name: shape_owner_set_one_way_collision_direction

classes.name: CollisionPolygon2D

values.name: BUILD_SOLIDS
values.description: Collisions will include the polygon and its contained area. In this mode the node has the same effect as several [ConvexPolygonShape2D] nodes, one for each convex shape in the convex decomposition of the polygon (but without the overhead of multiple nodes).

values.name: BUILD_SEGMENTS
values.description: Collisions will only include the polygon edges. In this mode the node has the same effect as a single [ConcavePolygonShape2D] made of segments, with the restriction that each segment (after the first one) starts where the previous one ends, and the last one ends where the first one starts (forming a closed but hollow polygon).

properties.name: polygon

The polygon's list of vertices. Each point will be connected to the next, and the final point will be connected to the first.

[b]Note:[/b] This property has no effect if this [CollisionPolygon2D] is a child of an [Area2D] node.
[b]Note:[/b] The one way collision direction can be configured by setting [member one_way_collision_direction].

classes.brief_description: This resource allows for creating a custom rendering effect.
classes.description: This resource defines a custom rendering effect that can be applied to [Viewport]s through the viewports' [Environment]. You can implement a callback that is called during rendering at a given stage of the rendering pipeline and allows you to insert additional passes. Note that this callback happens on the rendering thread. CompositorEffect is an abstract base class and must be extended to implement specific rendering logic.

classes.name: CompressedCubemap
classes.brief_description: An optionally compressed [Cubemap].
classes.description:
A cubemap that is loaded from a [code].ccube[/code] file. This file format is internal to Godot; it is created by importing other image formats with the import system. [CompressedCubemap] can use one of 4 compression methods:
- Lossless (WebP or PNG, uncompressed on the GPU)
- Lossy (WebP, uncompressed on the GPU)
- VRAM Compressed (compressed on the GPU)
- VRAM Uncompressed (uncompressed on the GPU)
- Basis Universal (compressed on the GPU. Lower file sizes than VRAM Compressed, but slower to compress and lower quality than VRAM Compressed)
Only [b]VRAM Compressed[/b] actually reduces the memory usage on the GPU. The [b]Lossless[/b] and [b]Lossy[/b] compression methods will reduce the required storage on disk, but they will not reduce memory usage on the GPU as the texture is sent to the GPU uncompressed.
Using [b]VRAM Compressed[/b] also improves loading times, as VRAM-compressed textures are faster to load compared to textures using lossless or lossy compression. VRAM compression can exhibit noticeable artifacts and is intended to be used for 3D rendering, not 2D.
See [Cubemap] for a general description of cubemaps.

classes.name: ConcavePolygonShape2D

properties.name: segments
properties.description: The array of points that make up the [ConcavePolygonShape2D]'s line segments. The array (of length divisible by two) is naturally divided into pairs (one pair for each segment); each pair consists of the starting point of a segment and the endpoint of a segment.

classes.brief_description: A 2D polyline shape used for physics collision.
classes.description:
A 2D polyline shape, intended for use in physics. Used internally in [CollisionPolygon2D] when it's in [constant CollisionPolygon2D.BUILD_SEGMENTS] mode.
Being just a collection of interconnected line segments, [ConcavePolygonShape2D] is the most freely configurable single 2D shape. It can be used to form polygons of any nature, or even shapes that don't enclose an area. However, [ConcavePolygonShape2D] is [i]hollow[/i] even if the interconnected line segments do enclose an area, which often makes it unsuitable for physics or detection.
[b]Note:[/b] When used for collision, [ConcavePolygonShape2D] is intended to work with static [CollisionShape2D] nodes like [StaticBody2D] and will likely not behave well for [CharacterBody2D]s or [RigidBody2D]s in a mode other than Static.
[b]Warning:[/b] Physics bodies that are small have a chance to clip through this shape when moving fast. This happens because on one frame, the physics body may be on the "outside" of the shape, and on the next frame it may be "inside" it. [ConcavePolygonShape2D] is hollow, so it won't detect a collision.
[b]Performance:[/b] Due to its complexity, [ConcavePolygonShape2D] is the slowest 2D collision shape to check collisions against. Its use should generally be limited to level geometry. If the polyline is closed, [CollisionPolygon2D]'s [constant CollisionPolygon2D.BUILD_SOLIDS] mode can be used, which decomposes the polygon into convex ones; see [ConvexPolygonShape2D]'s documentation for instructions.

classes.name: ConcavePolygonShape3D

methods.name: set_faces
methods.description: Sets the faces of the trimesh shape from an array of vertices. The [param faces] array should be composed of triples such that each triple of vertices defines a triangle.

methods.name: get_faces
methods.description: Returns the faces of the trimesh shape as an array of vertices. The array (of length divisible by three) is naturally divided into triples; each triple of vertices defines a triangle.

properties.name: backface_collision
properties.description: If set to [code]true[/code], collisions occur on both sides of the concave shape faces. Otherwise they occur only along the face normals.

classes.brief_description: A 3D trimesh shape used for physics collision.
classes.description:
A 3D trimesh shape, intended for use in physics. Usually used to provide a shape for a [CollisionShape3D].
Being just a collection of interconnected triangles, [ConcavePolygonShape3D] is the most freely configurable single 3D shape. It can be used to form polyhedra of any nature, or even shapes that don't enclose a volume. However, [ConcavePolygonShape3D] is [i]hollow[/i] even if the interconnected triangles do enclose a volume, which often makes it unsuitable for physics or detection.
[b]Note:[/b] When used for collision, [ConcavePolygonShape3D] is intended to work with static [CollisionShape3D] nodes like [StaticBody3D] and will likely not behave well for [CharacterBody3D]s or [RigidBody3D]s in a mode other than Static.
[b]Warning:[/b] Physics bodies that are small have a chance to clip through this shape when moving fast. This happens because on one frame, the physics body may be on the "outside" of the shape, and on the next frame it may be "inside" it. [ConcavePolygonShape3D] is hollow, so it won't detect a collision.
[b]Performance:[/b] Due to its complexity, [ConcavePolygonShape3D] is the slowest 3D collision shape to check collisions against. Its use should generally be limited to level geometry. For convex geometry, [ConvexPolygonShape3D] should be used. For dynamic physics bodies that need concave collision, several [ConvexPolygonShape3D]s can be used to represent its collision by using convex decomposition; see [ConvexPolygonShape3D]'s documentation for instructions.

classes.name: ConeTwistJoint3D

values.name: PARAM_SWING_SPAN
values.description:
Swing is rotation from side to side, around the axis perpendicular to the twist axis.
The swing span defines, how much rotation will not get corrected along the swing axis.
Could be defined as looseness in the [ConeTwistJoint3D].
If below 0.05, this behavior is locked.

values.name: PARAM_TWIST_SPAN
values.description:
Twist is the rotation around the twist axis, this value defined how far the joint can twist.
Twist is locked if below 0.05.

values.name: PARAM_BIAS

The higher, the faster.

values.name: PARAM_RELAXATION

classes.brief_description: A physics joint that connects two 3D physics bodies in a way that simulates a ball-and-socket joint.
classes.description: A physics joint that connects two 3D physics bodies in a way that simulates a ball-and-socket joint. The twist axis is initiated as the X axis of the [ConeTwistJoint3D]. Once the physics bodies swing, the twist axis is calculated as the middle of the X axes of the joint in the local space of the two physics bodies. Useful for limbs like shoulders and hips, lamps hanging off a ceiling, etc.

classes.name: ConfigFile

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Assigns a value to the specified key of the specified section. If either the section or the key do not exist, they are created. Passing a [code]null[/code] value deletes the specified key if it exists, and deletes the section if it ends up empty once the key has been removed.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Returns the current value for the specified section and key. If either the section or the key do not exist, the method returns the fallback [param default] value. If [param default] is not specified or set to [code]null[/code], an error is also raised.

methods.name: has_section
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the specified section exists.

methods.name: has_section_key
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the specified section-key pair exists.

methods.name: get_sections
methods.description: Returns an array of all defined section identifiers.

methods.name: get_section_keys
methods.description: Returns an array of all defined key identifiers in the specified section. Raises an error and returns an empty array if the section does not exist.

methods.name: erase_section
methods.description: Deletes the specified section along with all the key-value pairs inside. Raises an error if the section does not exist.

methods.name: erase_section_key
methods.description: Deletes the specified key in a section. Raises an error if either the section or the key do not exist.

methods.name: load
methods.description:
Loads the config file specified as a parameter. The file's contents are parsed and loaded in the [ConfigFile] object which the method was called on.
Returns [constant OK] on success, or one of the other [enum Error] values if the operation failed.

methods.name: parse
methods.description:
Parses the passed string as the contents of a config file. The string is parsed and loaded in the ConfigFile object which the method was called on.
Returns [constant OK] on success, or one of the other [enum Error] values if the operation failed.

methods.name: save
methods.description:
Saves the contents of the [ConfigFile] object to the file specified as a parameter. The output file uses an INI-style structure.
Returns [constant OK] on success, or one of the other [enum Error] values if the operation failed.

methods.name: encode_to_text
methods.description: Obtain the text version of this config file (the same text that would be written to a file).

methods.name: load_encrypted
methods.description:
Loads the encrypted config file specified as a parameter, using the provided [param key] to decrypt it. The file's contents are parsed and loaded in the [ConfigFile] object which the method was called on.
Returns [constant OK] on success, or one of the other [enum Error] values if the operation failed.

methods.name: load_encrypted_pass
methods.description:
Loads the encrypted config file specified as a parameter, using the provided [param password] to decrypt it. The file's contents are parsed and loaded in the [ConfigFile] object which the method was called on.
Returns [constant OK] on success, or one of the other [enum Error] values if the operation failed.

methods.name: save_encrypted
methods.description:
Saves the contents of the [ConfigFile] object to the AES-256 encrypted file specified as a parameter, using the provided [param key] to encrypt it. The output file uses an INI-style structure.
Returns [constant OK] on success, or one of the other [enum Error] values if the operation failed.

methods.name: save_encrypted_pass

classes.brief_description: A dialog used for confirmation of actions.
classes.description:
A dialog used for confirmation of actions. This window is similar to [AcceptDialog], but pressing its Cancel button can have a different outcome from pressing the OK button. The order of the two buttons varies depending on the host OS.
To get cancel action, you can use:
[codeblocks]
[gdscript]
get_cancel_button().pressed.connect(_on_canceled)
[/gdscript]
[csharp]
GetCancelButton().Pressed += OnCanceled;
[/csharp]
[/codeblocks]
[b]Note:[/b] [AcceptDialog] is invisible by default. To make it visible, call one of the [code]popup_*[/code] methods from [Window] on the node, such as [method Window.popup_centered_clamped].

constants.name: NOTIFICATION_RESIZED
constants.description: Sent when the node changes size. Use [member size] to get the new size.

constants.name: NOTIFICATION_MOUSE_ENTER
constants.description:
Sent when the mouse cursor enters the control's (or any child control's) visible area, that is not occluded behind other Controls or Windows, provided its [member mouse_filter] lets the event reach it and regardless if it's currently focused or not.
[b]Note:[/b] [member CanvasItem.z_index] doesn't affect which Control receives the notification.
See also [constant NOTIFICATION_MOUSE_ENTER_SELF].

constants.name: NOTIFICATION_MOUSE_EXIT
constants.description:
Sent when the mouse cursor leaves the control's (and all child control's) visible area, that is not occluded behind other Controls or Windows, provided its [member mouse_filter] lets the event reach it and regardless if it's currently focused or not.
[b]Note:[/b] [member CanvasItem.z_index] doesn't affect which Control receives the notification.
See also [constant NOTIFICATION_MOUSE_EXIT_SELF].

constants.name: NOTIFICATION_MOUSE_ENTER_SELF
constants.description:
Sent when the mouse cursor enters the control's visible area, that is not occluded behind other Controls or Windows, provided its [member mouse_filter] lets the event reach it and regardless if it's currently focused or not.
[b]Note:[/b] [member CanvasItem.z_index] doesn't affect which Control receives the notification.
See also [constant NOTIFICATION_MOUSE_ENTER].

constants.name: NOTIFICATION_MOUSE_EXIT_SELF
constants.description:
Sent when the mouse cursor leaves the control's visible area, that is not occluded behind other Controls or Windows, provided its [member mouse_filter] lets the event reach it and regardless if it's currently focused or not.
[b]Note:[/b] [member CanvasItem.z_index] doesn't affect which Control receives the notification.
See also [constant NOTIFICATION_MOUSE_EXIT].

constants.name: NOTIFICATION_FOCUS_ENTER
constants.description: Sent when the node grabs focus.

constants.name: NOTIFICATION_FOCUS_EXIT
constants.description:
Sent when the node loses focus.
This notification is sent in reversed order.

constants.name: NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED
constants.description:
Sent when the node needs to refresh its theme items. This happens in one of the following cases:
- The [member theme] property is changed on this node or any of its ancestors.
- The [member theme_type_variation] property is changed on this node.
- One of the node's theme property overrides is changed.
- The node enters the scene tree.
[b]Note:[/b] As an optimization, this notification won't be sent from changes that occur while this node is outside of the scene tree. Instead, all of the theme item updates can be applied at once when the node enters the scene tree.
[b]Note:[/b] This notification is received alongside [constant Node.NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE], so if you are instantiating a scene, the child nodes will not be initialized yet. You can use it to setup theming for this node, child nodes created from script, or if you want to access child nodes added in the editor, make sure the node is ready using [method Node.is_node_ready].
[codeblock]
func _notification(what):
	if what == NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED:
		if not is_node_ready():
			await ready # Wait until ready signal.
		$Label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.YELLOW)
[/codeblock]

constants.name: NOTIFICATION_SCROLL_BEGIN
constants.description:
Sent when this node is inside a [ScrollContainer] which has begun being scrolled when dragging the scrollable area [i]with a touch event[/i]. This notification is [i]not[/i] sent when scrolling by dragging the scrollbar, scrolling with the mouse wheel or scrolling with keyboard/gamepad events.
[b]Note:[/b] This signal is only emitted on Android or iOS, or on desktop/web platforms when [member ProjectSettings.input_devices/pointing/emulate_touch_from_mouse] is enabled.

constants.name: NOTIFICATION_SCROLL_END
constants.description:
Sent when this node is inside a [ScrollContainer] which has stopped being scrolled when dragging the scrollable area [i]with a touch event[/i]. This notification is [i]not[/i] sent when scrolling by dragging the scrollbar, scrolling with the mouse wheel or scrolling with keyboard/gamepad events.
[b]Note:[/b] This signal is only emitted on Android or iOS, or on desktop/web platforms when [member ProjectSettings.input_devices/pointing/emulate_touch_from_mouse] is enabled.

constants.name: NOTIFICATION_LAYOUT_DIRECTION_CHANGED
constants.description: Sent when the control layout direction is changed from LTR or RTL or vice versa. This notification is propagated to child Control nodes as result of a change to [member layout_direction].

values.name: FOCUS_NONE

values.description: The node can only grab focus on mouse clicks. Use with [member focus_mode].

values.name: FOCUS_ALL

values.name: FOCUS_ACCESSIBILITY
values.description: The node can grab focus only when screen reader is active. Use with [member focus_mode].

values.name: FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_INHERITED

values.name: FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED
values.description: Prevents the control from getting focused. [method get_focus_mode_with_override] will return [constant FOCUS_NONE].

values.name: FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_ENABLED
