methods.name: reset
methods.description:
Resets a simulating state with respect to the current bone pose.
It is useful to prevent the simulation result getting violent. For example, calling this immediately after a call to [method AnimationPlayer.play] without a fading, or within the previous [signal SkeletonModifier3D.modification_processed] signal if it's condition changes significantly.

properties.name: external_force
properties.description:
The constant force that always affected bones. It is equal to the result when the parent [Skeleton3D] moves at this speed in the opposite direction.
This is useful for effects such as wind and anti-gravity.

properties.name: mutable_bone_axes
properties.description:
If [code]true[/code], the solver retrieves the bone axis from the bone pose every frame.
If [code]false[/code], the solver retrieves the bone axis from the bone rest and caches it, which increases performance slightly, but position changes in the bone pose made before processing this [SpringBoneSimulator3D] are ignored.

properties.name: setting_count
properties.description: The number of settings.

classes.brief_description: A [SkeletonModifier3D] to apply inertial wavering to bone chains.
classes.description:
This [SkeletonModifier3D] can be used to wiggle hair, cloth, and tails. This modifier behaves differently from [PhysicalBoneSimulator3D] as it attempts to return the original pose after modification.
If you setup [method set_root_bone] and [method set_end_bone], it is treated as one bone chain. Note that it does not support a branched chain like Y-shaped chains.
When a bone chain is created, an array is generated from the bones that exist in between and listed in the joint list.
Several properties can be applied to each joint, such as [method set_joint_stiffness], [method set_joint_drag], and [method set_joint_gravity].
For simplicity, you can set values to all joints at the same time by using a [Curve]. If you want to specify detailed values individually, set [method set_individual_config] to [code]true[/code].
For physical simulation, [SpringBoneSimulator3D] can have children as self-standing collisions that are not related to [PhysicsServer3D], see also [SpringBoneCollision3D].
[b]Warning:[/b] A scaled [SpringBoneSimulator3D] will likely not behave as expected. Make sure that the parent [Skeleton3D] and its bones are not scaled.
[b]Note:[/b] Most methods in this class take an [code]index[/code] parameter. This parameter specifies which setting list entry to return if the IK has multiple entries (e.g. [code]settings/<index>/root_bone_name[/code]).

classes.name: Sprite2D

methods.name: is_pixel_opaque
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the pixel at the given position is opaque, [code]false[/code] otherwise. Also returns [code]false[/code] if the given position is out of bounds or this sprite's [member texture] is [code]null[/code]. [param pos] is in local coordinates.

signals.description: Emitted when the [member texture] changes.

properties.name: texture
properties.description: [Texture2D] object to draw.

properties.name: centered
properties.description:
If [code]true[/code], texture is centered.
[b]Note:[/b] For games with a pixel art aesthetic, textures may appear deformed when centered. This is caused by their position being between pixels. To prevent this, set this property to [code]false[/code], or consider enabling [member ProjectSettings.rendering/2d/snap/snap_2d_vertices_to_pixel] and [member ProjectSettings.rendering/2d/snap/snap_2d_transforms_to_pixel].

properties.name: offset
properties.description:
The texture's drawing offset.
[b]Note:[/b] When you increase [member offset].y in Sprite2D, the sprite moves downward on screen (i.e., +Y is down).

properties.name: flip_h
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], texture is flipped horizontally.

properties.name: flip_v
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], texture is flipped vertically.

properties.name: hframes
properties.description: The number of columns in the sprite sheet. When this property is changed, [member frame] is adjusted so that the same visual frame is maintained (same row and column). If that's impossible, [member frame] is reset to [code]0[/code].

properties.name: vframes
properties.description: The number of rows in the sprite sheet. When this property is changed, [member frame] is adjusted so that the same visual frame is maintained (same row and column). If that's impossible, [member frame] is reset to [code]0[/code].

properties.name: frame
properties.description: Current frame to display from sprite sheet. [member hframes] or [member vframes] must be greater than 1. This property is automatically adjusted when [member hframes] or [member vframes] are changed to keep pointing to the same visual frame (same column and row). If that's impossible, this value is reset to [code]0[/code].

properties.name: frame_coords
properties.description: Coordinates of the frame to display from sprite sheet. This is as an alias for the [member frame] property. [member hframes] or [member vframes] must be greater than 1.

properties.name: region_enabled
properties.description:
If [code]true[/code], texture is cut from a larger atlas texture. See [member region_rect].
[b]Note:[/b] When using a custom [Shader] on a [Sprite2D], the [code]UV[/code] shader built-in will refer to the entire texture space. Use the [code]REGION_RECT[/code] built-in to get the currently visible region defined in [member region_rect] instead. See [url=$DOCS_URL/tutorials/shaders/shader_reference/canvas_item_shader.html]CanvasItem shaders[/url] for details.

properties.name: region_rect
properties.description: The region of the atlas texture to display. [member region_enabled] must be [code]true[/code].

properties.name: region_filter_clip_enabled
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the area outside of the [member region_rect] is clipped to avoid bleeding of the surrounding texture pixels. [member region_enabled] must be [code]true[/code].

classes.name: SpriteBase3D

values.name: FLAG_TRANSPARENT
values.description: If set, the texture's transparency and the opacity are used to make those parts of the sprite invisible.

values.name: FLAG_SHADED
values.description: If set, lights in the environment affect the sprite.

values.name: FLAG_DOUBLE_SIDED
values.description: If set, texture can be seen from the back as well. If not, the texture is invisible when looking at it from behind.

values.name: FLAG_DISABLE_DEPTH_TEST
values.description: Disables the depth test, so this object is drawn on top of all others. However, objects drawn after it in the draw order may cover it.

values.name: FLAG_FIXED_SIZE
values.description: Label is scaled by depth so that it always appears the same size on screen.

values.name: FLAG_MAX
values.description: Represents the size of the [enum DrawFlags] enum.

values.name: ALPHA_CUT_DISABLED
values.description: This mode performs standard alpha blending. It can display translucent areas, but transparency sorting issues may be visible when multiple transparent materials are overlapping.

values.name: ALPHA_CUT_DISCARD
values.description: This mode only allows fully transparent or fully opaque pixels. Harsh edges will be visible unless some form of screen-space antialiasing is enabled (see [member ProjectSettings.rendering/anti_aliasing/quality/screen_space_aa]). On the bright side, this mode doesn't suffer from transparency sorting issues when multiple transparent materials are overlapping. This mode is also known as [i]alpha testing[/i] or [i]1-bit transparency[/i].

values.name: ALPHA_CUT_OPAQUE_PREPASS
values.description: This mode draws fully opaque pixels in the depth prepass. This is slower than [constant ALPHA_CUT_DISABLED] or [constant ALPHA_CUT_DISCARD], but it allows displaying translucent areas and smooth edges while using proper sorting.

values.name: ALPHA_CUT_HASH
values.description: This mode draws cuts off all values below a spatially-deterministic threshold, the rest will remain opaque.

methods.name: set_draw_flag
methods.description: If [code]true[/code], the specified flag will be enabled.

methods.name: get_draw_flag
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified flag.

methods.name: get_item_rect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle representing this sprite.

methods.name: generate_triangle_mesh
methods.description: Returns a [TriangleMesh] with the sprite's vertices following its current configuration (such as its [member axis] and [member pixel_size]).

properties.name: centered
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], texture will be centered.

properties.name: offset
properties.description:
The texture's drawing offset.
[b]Note:[/b] When you increase [member offset].y in Sprite3D, the sprite moves upward in world space (i.e., +Y is up).

properties.name: flip_h
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], texture is flipped horizontally.

properties.name: flip_v
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], texture is flipped vertically.

properties.name: modulate
properties.description:
A color value used to [i]multiply[/i] the texture's colors. Can be used for mood-coloring or to simulate the color of ambient light.
[b]Note:[/b] Unlike [member CanvasItem.modulate] for 2D, colors with values above [code]1.0[/code] (overbright) are not supported.
[b]Note:[/b] If a [member GeometryInstance3D.material_override] is defined on the [SpriteBase3D], the material override must be configured to take vertex colors into account for albedo. Otherwise, the color defined in [member modulate] will be ignored. For a [BaseMaterial3D], [member BaseMaterial3D.vertex_color_use_as_albedo] must be [code]true[/code]. For a [ShaderMaterial], [code]ALBEDO *= COLOR.rgb;[/code] must be inserted in the shader's [code]fragment()[/code] function.

properties.name: pixel_size
properties.description: The size of one pixel's width on the sprite to scale it in 3D.

properties.name: axis
properties.description: The direction in which the front of the texture faces.

properties.name: billboard
properties.description:
The billboard mode to use for the sprite.
[b]Note:[/b] When billboarding is enabled and the material also casts shadows, billboards will face [b]the[/b] camera in the scene when rendering shadows. In scenes with multiple cameras, the intended shadow cannot be determined and this will result in undefined behavior. See [url=https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/72638]GitHub Pull Request #72638[/url] for details.

properties.name: transparent
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the texture's transparency and the opacity are used to make those parts of the sprite invisible.

properties.name: shaded
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the [Light3D] in the [Environment] has effects on the sprite.

properties.name: double_sided
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], texture can be seen from the back as well, if [code]false[/code], it is invisible when looking at it from behind.

properties.name: no_depth_test
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], depth testing is disabled and the object will be drawn in render order.

properties.name: fixed_size
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the texture is rendered at the same size regardless of distance. The texture's size on screen is the same as if the camera was [code]1.0[/code] units away from the texture's origin, regardless of the actual distance from the camera. The [Camera3D]'s field of view (or [member Camera3D.size] when in orthogonal/frustum mode) still affects the size the sprite is drawn at.

properties.name: alpha_cut
properties.description: The alpha cutting mode to use for the sprite.

properties.name: alpha_scissor_threshold
properties.description: Threshold at which the alpha scissor will discard values.

properties.name: alpha_hash_scale
properties.description: The hashing scale for Alpha Hash. Recommended values between [code]0[/code] and [code]2[/code].

properties.name: alpha_antialiasing_mode
properties.description: The type of alpha antialiasing to apply.

properties.name: alpha_antialiasing_edge
properties.description: Threshold at which antialiasing will be applied on the alpha channel.

properties.name: texture_filter
properties.description:
Filter flags for the texture.
[b]Note:[/b] Linear filtering may cause artifacts around the edges, which are especially noticeable on opaque textures. To prevent this, use textures with transparent or identical colors around the edges.

properties.name: render_priority
properties.description:
Sets the render priority for the sprite. Higher priority objects will be sorted in front of lower priority objects.
[b]Note:[/b] This only applies if [member alpha_cut] is set to [constant ALPHA_CUT_DISABLED] (default value).
[b]Note:[/b] This only applies to sorting of transparent objects. This will not impact how transparent objects are sorted relative to opaque objects. This is because opaque objects are not sorted, while transparent objects are sorted from back to front (subject to priority).

values.name: LOOP_NONE
values.description: The animation plays once and stops when it reaches the end, or the start if played in reverse.

values.name: LOOP_LINEAR
values.description: The animation restarts from the beginning when it reaches the end, or from the end if played in reverse, repeating continuously.

values.name: LOOP_PINGPONG
values.description:
The animation alternates direction each time it reaches the end or start, playing forward and then in reverse repeatedly.
[b]Note:[/b] Both [AnimatedSprite2D] and [AnimatedSprite3D] play the first/last frame for its duration only once at each end of the animation loop (instead of twice, once per forward/backward animation direction).

methods.description:
If [param loop] is [code]false[/code] equivalent to [code]set_animation_loop_mode(LOOP_NONE)[/code].
If [param loop] is [code]true[/code] equivalent to [code]set_animation_loop_mode(LOOP_LINEAR)[/code].

methods.name: get_animation_loop
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [code]get_animation_loop_mode(anim) == LOOP_LINEAR[/code]. Otherwise, returns [code]false[/code].

methods.name: set_animation_loop_mode
methods.description: Sets the [param loop_mode] for the [param anim] animation.

methods.name: get_animation_loop_mode
methods.description: Returns the loop mode for the [param anim] animation.

methods.name: add_frame
methods.description: Adds a frame to the [param anim] animation. If [param at_position] is [code]-1[/code], the frame will be added to the end of the animation. [param duration] specifies the relative duration, see [method get_frame_duration] for details.

methods.name: set_frame
methods.description: Sets the [param texture] and the [param duration] of the frame [param idx] in the [param anim] animation. [param duration] specifies the relative duration, see [method get_frame_duration] for details.

methods.name: remove_frame
methods.description: Removes the [param anim] animation's frame [param idx].

methods.name: get_frame_count
methods.description: Returns the number of frames for the [param anim] animation.

methods.name: get_frame_texture
methods.description: Returns the texture of the frame [param idx] in the [param anim] animation.

methods.name: get_frame_duration
methods.description:
Returns a relative duration of the frame [param idx] in the [param anim] animation (defaults to [code]1.0[/code]). For example, a frame with a duration of [code]2.0[/code] is displayed twice as long as a frame with a duration of [code]1.0[/code]. You can calculate the absolute duration (in seconds) of a frame using the following formula:
[codeblock]
absolute_duration = relative_duration / (animation_fps * abs(playing_speed))
[/codeblock]
In this example, [code]playing_speed[/code] refers to either [method AnimatedSprite2D.get_playing_speed] or [method AnimatedSprite3D.get_playing_speed].

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all frames from the [param anim] animation.

methods.name: clear_all
methods.description: Removes all animations. An empty [code]default[/code] animation will be created.

classes.brief_description: A 2D physics body that can't be moved by external forces. When moved manually, it doesn't affect other bodies in its path.
classes.description:
A static 2D physics body. It can't be moved by external forces or contacts, but can be moved manually by other means such as code, [AnimationMixer]s (with [member AnimationMixer.callback_mode_process] set to [constant AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS]), and [RemoteTransform2D].
When [StaticBody2D] is moved, it is teleported to its new position without affecting other physics bodies in its path. If this is not desired, use [AnimatableBody2D] instead.
[StaticBody2D] is useful for completely static objects like floors and walls, as well as moving surfaces like conveyor belts and circular revolving platforms (by using [member constant_linear_velocity] and [member constant_angular_velocity]).

When [StaticBody3D] is moved, it is teleported to its new position without affecting other physics bodies in its path. If this is not desired, use [AnimatableBody3D] instead.
[StaticBody3D] is useful for completely static objects like floors and walls, as well as moving surfaces like conveyor belts and circular revolving platforms (by using [member constant_linear_velocity] and [member constant_angular_velocity]).

classes.name: StreamPeer

methods.name: put_data
methods.description: Sends a chunk of data through the connection, blocking if necessary until the data is done sending. This function returns an [enum Error] code.

methods.name: put_partial_data
methods.description: Sends a chunk of data through the connection. If all the data could not be sent at once, only part of it will. This function returns two values, an [enum Error] code and an integer, describing how much data was actually sent.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Returns a chunk data with the received bytes, as an [Array] containing two elements: an [enum Error] constant and a [PackedByteArray]. [param bytes] is the number of bytes to be received. If not enough bytes are available, the function will block until the desired amount is received.

methods.name: get_partial_data
methods.description: Returns a chunk data with the received bytes, as an [Array] containing two elements: an [enum Error] constant and a [PackedByteArray]. [param bytes] is the number of bytes to be received. If not enough bytes are available, the function will return how many were actually received.

methods.name: get_available_bytes
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes this [StreamPeer] has available.

methods.name: put_8
methods.description: Puts a signed byte into the stream.

methods.name: put_u8
methods.description: Puts an unsigned byte into the stream.

methods.name: put_16
methods.description: Puts a signed 16-bit value into the stream.

methods.name: put_u16
methods.description: Puts an unsigned 16-bit value into the stream.

methods.name: put_32
methods.description: Puts a signed 32-bit value into the stream.

methods.name: put_u32
methods.description: Puts an unsigned 32-bit value into the stream.

methods.name: put_64
methods.description: Puts a signed 64-bit value into the stream.

methods.name: put_u64
methods.description: Puts an unsigned 64-bit value into the stream.

methods.name: put_half
methods.description: Puts a half-precision float into the stream.

methods.name: put_float
methods.description: Puts a single-precision float into the stream.

methods.name: put_double
methods.description: Puts a double-precision float into the stream.

methods.name: put_string
methods.description:
Puts a zero-terminated ASCII string into the stream prepended by a 32-bit unsigned integer representing its size.
[b]Note:[/b] To put an ASCII string without prepending its size, you can use [method put_data]:
[codeblocks]
[gdscript]
put_data("Hello world".to_ascii_buffer())
[/gdscript]
[csharp]
PutData("Hello World".ToAsciiBuffer());
[/csharp]
[/codeblocks]

methods.name: put_utf8_string
methods.description:
Puts a zero-terminated UTF-8 string into the stream prepended by a 32 bits unsigned integer representing its size.
[b]Note:[/b] To put a UTF-8 string without prepending its size, you can use [method put_data]:
[codeblocks]
[gdscript]
put_data("Hello world".to_utf8_buffer())
[/gdscript]
[csharp]
PutData("Hello World".ToUtf8Buffer());
[/csharp]
[/codeblocks]

methods.name: put_var
methods.description:
Puts a Variant into the stream. If [param full_objects] is [code]true[/code] encoding objects is allowed (and can potentially include code).
Internally, this uses the same encoding mechanism as the [method @GlobalScope.var_to_bytes] method.

methods.name: get_8
methods.description: Gets a signed byte from the stream.

methods.name: get_u8
methods.description: Gets an unsigned byte from the stream.

methods.name: get_16
methods.description: Gets a signed 16-bit value from the stream.

methods.name: get_u16
methods.description: Gets an unsigned 16-bit value from the stream.

methods.name: get_32
methods.description: Gets a signed 32-bit value from the stream.

methods.name: get_u32
methods.description: Gets an unsigned 32-bit value from the stream.

methods.name: get_64
methods.description: Gets a signed 64-bit value from the stream.

methods.name: get_u64
methods.description: Gets an unsigned 64-bit value from the stream.

methods.name: get_half
methods.description: Gets a half-precision float from the stream.

methods.name: get_float
methods.description: Gets a single-precision float from the stream.

methods.name: get_double
methods.description: Gets a double-precision float from the stream.

methods.name: get_string
methods.description: Gets an ASCII string with byte-length [param bytes] from the stream. If [param bytes] is negative (default) the length will be read from the stream using the reverse process of [method put_string].

methods.name: get_utf8_string
methods.description: Gets a UTF-8 string with byte-length [param bytes] from the stream (this decodes the string sent as UTF-8). If [param bytes] is negative (default) the length will be read from the stream using the reverse process of [method put_utf8_string].

methods.name: get_var
methods.description:
Gets a Variant from the stream. If [param allow_objects] is [code]true[/code], decoding objects is allowed.
Internally, this uses the same decoding mechanism as the [method @GlobalScope.bytes_to_var] method.
[b]Warning:[/b] Deserialized objects can contain code which gets executed. Do not use this option if the serialized object comes from untrusted sources to avoid potential security threats such as remote code execution.

properties.name: big_endian
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], this [StreamPeer] will using big-endian format for encoding and decoding.

classes.brief_description: Abstract base class for interacting with streams.
classes.description:
StreamPeer is an abstract base class mostly used for stream-based protocols (such as TCP). It provides an API for sending and receiving data through streams as raw data or strings.
[b]Note:[/b] When exporting to Android, make sure to enable the [code]INTERNET[/code] permission in the Android export preset before exporting the project or using one-click deploy. Otherwise, network communication of any kind will be blocked by Android.

classes.name: StreamPeerBuffer

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the cursor to the specified position. [param position] must be a valid index of [member data_array].

methods.name: get_size
methods.description: Returns the size of [member data_array].

methods.name: get_position
methods.description: Returns the current cursor position.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the [member data_array]. This [i]doesn't[/i] update the cursor.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the [member data_array] and resets the cursor.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.description: Returns a new [StreamPeerBuffer] with the same [member data_array] content.

properties.name: data_array
properties.description: The underlying data buffer. Setting this value resets the cursor.

classes.brief_description: A stream peer used to handle binary data streams.
classes.description:
A data buffer stream peer that uses a byte array as the stream. This object can be used to handle binary data from network sessions. To handle binary data stored in files, [FileAccess] can be used directly.
A [StreamPeerBuffer] object keeps an internal cursor which is the offset in bytes to the start of the buffer. Get and put operations are performed at the cursor position and will move the cursor accordingly.

classes.name: StreamPeerGZIP

methods.name: start_compression
methods.description: Start the stream in compression mode with the given [param buffer_size], if [param use_deflate] is [code]true[/code] uses deflate instead of GZIP.

methods.name: start_decompression
methods.description: Start the stream in decompression mode with the given [param buffer_size], if [param use_deflate] is [code]true[/code] uses deflate instead of GZIP.

methods.name: finish
methods.description:
Finalizes the stream, compressing any buffered chunk left.
You must call it only when you are compressing.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears this stream, resetting the internal state.

classes.brief_description: A stream peer that handles GZIP and deflate compression/decompression.
classes.description:
This class allows to compress or decompress data using GZIP/deflate in a streaming fashion. This is particularly useful when compressing or decompressing files that have to be sent through the network without needing to allocate them all in memory.
After starting the stream via [method start_compression] (or [method start_decompression]), calling [method StreamPeer.put_partial_data] on this stream will compress (or decompress) the data, writing it to the internal buffer. Calling [method StreamPeer.get_available_bytes] will return the pending bytes in the internal buffer, and [method StreamPeer.get_partial_data] will retrieve the compressed (or decompressed) bytes from it. When the stream is over, you must call [method finish] to ensure the internal buffer is properly flushed (make sure to call [method StreamPeer.get_available_bytes] on last time to check if more data needs to be read after that).

classes.description: StreamPeerSocket is an abstract base class that defines common behavior for socket-based streams.

classes.name: StreamPeerTCP

methods.name: bind
methods.description:
Opens the TCP socket, and binds it to the specified local address.
This method is generally not needed, and only used to force the subsequent call to [method connect_to_host] to use the specified [param host] and [param port] as source address. This can be desired in some NAT punchthrough techniques, or when forcing the source network interface.

methods.name: connect_to_host
methods.description: Connects to the specified [code]host:port[/code] pair. A hostname will be resolved if valid. Returns [constant OK] on success.

methods.name: get_connected_host
methods.description: Returns the IP of this peer.

methods.name: get_connected_port
methods.description: Returns the port of this peer.

methods.name: get_local_port
methods.description: Returns the local port to which this peer is bound.

methods.name: set_no_delay
methods.description:
If [param enabled] is [code]true[/code], packets will be sent immediately. If [param enabled] is [code]false[/code] (the default), packet transfers will be delayed and combined using [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagle%27s_algorithm]Nagle's algorithm[/url].
[b]Note:[/b] It's recommended to leave this disabled for applications that send large packets or need to transfer a lot of data, as enabling this can decrease the total available bandwidth.

classes.brief_description: A stream peer that handles TCP connections.
classes.description:
A stream peer that handles TCP connections. This object can be used to connect to TCP servers, or also is returned by a TCP server.
[b]Note:[/b] When exporting to Android, make sure to enable the [code]INTERNET[/code] permission in the Android export preset before exporting the project or using one-click deploy. Otherwise, network communication of any kind will be blocked by Android.

values.description: An error status that shows a mismatch in the TLS certificate domain presented by the host and the domain requested for validation.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Poll the connection to check for incoming bytes. Call this right before [method StreamPeer.get_available_bytes] for it to work properly.

methods.name: accept_stream
methods.description: Accepts a peer connection as a server using the given [param server_options]. See [method TLSOptions.server].

methods.name: connect_to_stream
methods.description: Connects to a peer using an underlying [StreamPeer] [param stream] and verifying the remote certificate is correctly signed for the given [param common_name]. You can pass the optional [param client_options] parameter to customize the trusted certification authorities, or disable the common name verification. See [method TLSOptions.client] and [method TLSOptions.client_unsafe].

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Returns the status of the connection.

methods.name: get_stream
methods.description: Returns the underlying [StreamPeer] connection, used in [method accept_stream] or [method connect_to_stream].

methods.name: disconnect_from_stream
methods.description: Disconnects from host.

A stream peer that handles TLS connections. This object can be used to connect to a TLS server or accept a single TLS client connection.
[b]Note:[/b] When exporting to Android, make sure to enable the [code]INTERNET[/code] permission in the Android export preset before exporting the project or using one-click deploy. Otherwise, network communication of any kind will be blocked by Android.

Opens the UDS socket, and binds it to the specified socket path.

classes.description:
A stream peer that handles UNIX Domain Socket (UDS) connections. This object can be used to connect to UDS servers, or also is returned by a UDS server. Unix Domain Sockets provide inter-process communication on the same machine using the filesystem namespace.
[b]Note:[/b] UNIX Domain Sockets are only available on UNIX-like systems (Linux, macOS, etc.) and are not supported on Windows.

classes.name: StyleBox

methods.name: _get_minimum_size
methods.description: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns a custom minimum size that the stylebox must respect when drawing. By default [method get_minimum_size] only takes content margins into account. This method can be overridden to add another size restriction. A combination of the default behavior and the output of this method will be used, to account for both sizes.

methods.name: get_minimum_size
methods.description: Returns the minimum size that this stylebox can be shrunk to.

methods.name: set_content_margin
methods.description: Sets the default value of the specified [enum Side] to [param offset] pixels.

methods.name: set_content_margin_all
methods.description: Sets the default margin to [param offset] pixels for all sides.

methods.name: get_content_margin
methods.description: Returns the default margin of the specified [enum Side].

methods.name: get_margin
methods.description:
Returns the content margin offset for the specified [enum Side].
Positive values reduce size inwards, unlike [Control]'s margin values.

methods.name: get_offset
methods.description: Returns the "offset" of a stylebox. This helper function returns a value equivalent to [code]Vector2(style.get_margin(MARGIN_LEFT), style.get_margin(MARGIN_TOP))[/code].

methods.name: draw
methods.description:
Draws this stylebox using a canvas item identified by the given [RID].
The [RID] value can either be the result of [method CanvasItem.get_canvas_item] called on an existing [CanvasItem]-derived node, or directly from creating a canvas item in the [RenderingServer] with [method RenderingServer.canvas_item_create].

methods.name: get_current_item_drawn
methods.description: Returns the [CanvasItem] that handles its [constant CanvasItem.NOTIFICATION_DRAW] or [method CanvasItem._draw] callback at this moment.

methods.name: test_mask
methods.description: Test a position in a rectangle, return whether it passes the mask test.

properties.name: content_margin_left
properties.description:
The left margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the left.
Refer to [member content_margin_bottom] for extra considerations.

properties.name: content_margin_top
properties.description:
The top margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the top.
Refer to [member content_margin_bottom] for extra considerations.

properties.name: content_margin_right
properties.description:
The right margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the right.
Refer to [member content_margin_bottom] for extra considerations.

properties.name: content_margin_bottom
properties.description:
The bottom margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the bottom.
If this value is negative, it is ignored and a child-specific margin is used instead. For example, for [StyleBoxFlat], the border thickness (if any) is used instead.
It is up to the code using this style box to decide what these contents are: for example, a [Button] respects this content margin for the textual contents of the button.
[method get_margin] should be used to fetch this value as consumer instead of reading these properties directly. This is because it correctly respects negative values and the fallback mentioned above.

classes.brief_description: Abstract base class for defining stylized boxes for UI elements.
classes.description:
[StyleBox] is an abstract base class for drawing stylized boxes for UI elements. It is used for panels, buttons, [LineEdit] backgrounds, [Tree] backgrounds, etc. and also for testing a transparency mask for pointer signals. If mask test fails on a [StyleBox] assigned as mask to a control, clicks and motion signals will go through it to the one below.
[b]Note:[/b] For control nodes that have [i]Theme Properties[/i], the [code]focus[/code] [StyleBox] is displayed over the [code]normal[/code], [code]hover[/code] or [code]pressed[/code] [StyleBox]. This makes the [code]focus[/code] [StyleBox] more reusable across different nodes.

classes.name: StyleBoxEmpty
classes.brief_description: An empty [StyleBox] (does not display anything).
classes.description: An empty [StyleBox] that can be used to display nothing instead of the default style (e.g. it can "disable" [code]focus[/code] styles).

classes.name: StyleBoxFlat

methods.name: set_border_width_all
methods.description: Sets the border width to [param width] pixels for all sides.

methods.name: get_border_width_min
methods.description: Returns the smallest border width out of all four borders.

methods.name: set_border_width
methods.description: Sets the specified [enum Side]'s border width to [param width] pixels.

methods.name: get_border_width
methods.description: Returns the specified [enum Side]'s border width.

methods.name: set_corner_radius_all
methods.description: Sets the corner radius to [param radius] pixels for all corners.

methods.name: set_corner_radius
methods.description: Sets the corner radius to [param radius] pixels for the given [param corner].

methods.name: get_corner_radius
methods.description: Returns the given [param corner]'s radius.

methods.name: set_expand_margin
methods.description: Sets the expand margin to [param size] pixels for the specified [enum Side].

methods.name: set_expand_margin_all
methods.description: Sets the expand margin to [param size] pixels for all sides.

methods.name: get_expand_margin
methods.description: Returns the size of the specified [enum Side]'s expand margin.

properties.name: bg_color
properties.description: The background color of the stylebox.

properties.name: draw_center
properties.description: Toggles drawing of the inner part of the stylebox.

properties.name: skew
properties.description:
If set to a non-zero value on either axis, [member skew] distorts the StyleBox horizontally and/or vertically. This can be used for "futuristic"-style UIs. Positive values skew the StyleBox towards the right (X axis) and upwards (Y axis), while negative values skew the StyleBox towards the left (X axis) and downwards (Y axis).
[b]Note:[/b] To ensure text does not touch the StyleBox's edges, consider increasing the [StyleBox]'s content margin (see [member StyleBox.content_margin_bottom]). It is preferable to increase the content margin instead of the expand margin (see [member expand_margin_bottom]), as increasing the expand margin does not increase the size of the clickable area for [Control]s.

properties.name: border_width_left
properties.description: Border width for the left border.

properties.name: border_width_top
properties.description: Border width for the top border.

properties.name: border_width_right
properties.description: Border width for the right border.

properties.name: border_width_bottom
properties.description: Border width for the bottom border.

properties.name: border_color
properties.description: Sets the color of the border.

properties.name: border_blend
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the border will fade into the background color.

properties.name: corner_radius_top_left
properties.description: The top-left corner's radius. If [code]0[/code], the corner is not rounded.

properties.name: corner_radius_top_right
properties.description: The top-right corner's radius. If [code]0[/code], the corner is not rounded.

properties.name: corner_radius_bottom_right
properties.description: The bottom-right corner's radius. If [code]0[/code], the corner is not rounded.

properties.name: corner_radius_bottom_left
properties.description: The bottom-left corner's radius. If [code]0[/code], the corner is not rounded.

properties.name: corner_detail
properties.description:
This sets the number of vertices used for each corner. Higher values result in rounder corners but take more processing power to compute. When choosing a value, you should take the corner radius ([method set_corner_radius_all]) into account.
For corner radii less than 10, [code]4[/code] or [code]5[/code] should be enough. For corner radii less than 30, values between [code]8[/code] and [code]12[/code] should be enough.
A corner detail of [code]1[/code] will result in chamfered corners instead of rounded corners, which is useful for some artistic effects.

properties.name: expand_margin_left
properties.description:
Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the left edge. Useful in combination with [member border_width_left] to draw a border outside the control rect.
[b]Note:[/b] Unlike [member StyleBox.content_margin_left], [member expand_margin_left] does [i]not[/i] affect the size of the clickable area for [Control]s. This can negatively impact usability if used wrong, as the user may try to click an area of the StyleBox that cannot actually receive clicks.

properties.name: expand_margin_top
properties.description:
Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the top edge. Useful in combination with [member border_width_top] to draw a border outside the control rect.
[b]Note:[/b] Unlike [member StyleBox.content_margin_top], [member expand_margin_top] does [i]not[/i] affect the size of the clickable area for [Control]s. This can negatively impact usability if used wrong, as the user may try to click an area of the StyleBox that cannot actually receive clicks.

properties.name: expand_margin_right
properties.description:
Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the right edge. Useful in combination with [member border_width_right] to draw a border outside the control rect.
[b]Note:[/b] Unlike [member StyleBox.content_margin_right], [member expand_margin_right] does [i]not[/i] affect the size of the clickable area for [Control]s. This can negatively impact usability if used wrong, as the user may try to click an area of the StyleBox that cannot actually receive clicks.

properties.name: expand_margin_bottom
properties.description:
Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the bottom edge. Useful in combination with [member border_width_bottom] to draw a border outside the control rect.
[b]Note:[/b] Unlike [member StyleBox.content_margin_bottom], [member expand_margin_bottom] does [i]not[/i] affect the size of the clickable area for [Control]s. This can negatively impact usability if used wrong, as the user may try to click an area of the StyleBox that cannot actually receive clicks.

properties.name: shadow_color
properties.description: The color of the shadow. This has no effect if [member shadow_size] is lower than 1.

properties.name: shadow_size
properties.description: The shadow size in pixels.

properties.name: shadow_offset
properties.description: The shadow offset in pixels. Adjusts the position of the shadow relatively to the stylebox.

properties.name: anti_aliasing
properties.description:
Antialiasing draws a small ring around the edges, which fades to transparency. As a result, edges look much smoother. This is only noticeable when using rounded corners or [member skew].
[b]Note:[/b] When using beveled corners with 45-degree angles ([member corner_detail] = 1), it is recommended to set [member anti_aliasing] to [code]false[/code] to ensure crisp visuals and avoid possible visual glitches.

properties.name: anti_aliasing_size
properties.description:
This changes the size of the antialiasing effect. [code]1.0[/code] is recommended for an optimal result at 100% scale, identical to how rounded rectangles are rendered in web browsers and most vector drawing software.
[b]Note:[/b] Higher values may produce a blur effect but can also create undesired artifacts on small boxes with large-radius corners.

classes.brief_description: A customizable [StyleBox] that doesn't use a texture.
classes.description:
By configuring various properties of this style box, you can achieve many common looks without the need of a texture. This includes optionally rounded borders, antialiasing, shadows, and skew.
Setting corner radius to high values is allowed. As soon as corners overlap, the stylebox will switch to a relative system:
[codeblock lang=text]
height = 30
corner_radius_top_left = 50
corner_radius_bottom_left = 100
[/codeblock]
The relative system now would take the 1:2 ratio of the two left corners to calculate the actual corner width. Both corners added will [b]never[/b] be more than the height. Result:
[codeblock lang=text]
corner_radius_top_left: 10
corner_radius_bottom_left: 20
[/codeblock]

classes.name: StyleBoxLine

properties.name: color
properties.description: The line's color.

properties.name: grow_begin
properties.description: The number of pixels the line will extend before the [StyleBoxLine]'s bounds. If set to a negative value, the line will begin inside the [StyleBoxLine]'s bounds.

properties.name: grow_end
properties.description: The number of pixels the line will extend past the [StyleBoxLine]'s bounds. If set to a negative value, the line will end inside the [StyleBoxLine]'s bounds.

properties.name: thickness
properties.description: The line's thickness in pixels.

properties.name: vertical
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the line will be vertical. If [code]false[/code], the line will be horizontal.

classes.brief_description: A [StyleBox] that displays a single line of a given color and thickness.
classes.description: A [StyleBox] that displays a single line of a given color and thickness. The line can be either horizontal or vertical. Useful for separators.

classes.name: StyleBoxTexture

values.name: AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_STRETCH
values.description: Stretch the stylebox's texture. This results in visible distortion unless the texture size matches the stylebox's size perfectly.

values.name: AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_TILE
values.description: Repeats the stylebox's texture to match the stylebox's size according to the nine-patch system.

values.name: AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_TILE_FIT
values.description: Repeats the stylebox's texture to match the stylebox's size according to the nine-patch system. Unlike [constant AXIS_STRETCH_MODE_TILE], the texture may be slightly stretched to make the nine-patch texture tile seamlessly.

methods.name: set_texture_margin
methods.description: Sets the margin to [param size] pixels for the specified [enum Side].

methods.name: set_texture_margin_all
methods.description: Sets the margin to [param size] pixels for all sides.

methods.name: get_texture_margin
methods.description: Returns the margin size of the specified [enum Side].

methods.name: set_expand_margin
methods.description: Sets the expand margin to [param size] pixels for the specified [enum Side].

methods.name: set_expand_margin_all
methods.description: Sets the expand margin to [param size] pixels for all sides.

methods.name: get_expand_margin
methods.description: Returns the expand margin size of the specified [enum Side].

properties.name: texture
properties.description: The texture to use when drawing this style box.

properties.name: texture_margin_left
properties.description:
Increases the left margin of the 3×3 texture box.
A higher value means more of the source texture is considered to be part of the left border of the 3×3 box.
This is also the value used as fallback for [member StyleBox.content_margin_left] if it is negative.

properties.name: texture_margin_top
properties.description:
Increases the top margin of the 3×3 texture box.
A higher value means more of the source texture is considered to be part of the top border of the 3×3 box.
This is also the value used as fallback for [member StyleBox.content_margin_top] if it is negative.

properties.name: texture_margin_right
properties.description:
Increases the right margin of the 3×3 texture box.
A higher value means more of the source texture is considered to be part of the right border of the 3×3 box.
This is also the value used as fallback for [member StyleBox.content_margin_right] if it is negative.

properties.name: texture_margin_bottom
properties.description:
Increases the bottom margin of the 3×3 texture box.
A higher value means more of the source texture is considered to be part of the bottom border of the 3×3 box.
This is also the value used as fallback for [member StyleBox.content_margin_bottom] if it is negative.

properties.name: expand_margin_left
properties.description: Expands the left margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.

properties.name: expand_margin_top
properties.description: Expands the top margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.

properties.name: expand_margin_right
properties.description: Expands the right margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.

properties.name: expand_margin_bottom
properties.description: Expands the bottom margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.

properties.name: axis_stretch_horizontal
properties.description: Controls how the stylebox's texture will be stretched or tiled horizontally.

properties.name: axis_stretch_vertical
properties.description: Controls how the stylebox's texture will be stretched or tiled vertically.

properties.name: region_rect
properties.description:
The region to use from the [member texture].
This is equivalent to first wrapping the [member texture] in an [AtlasTexture] with the same region.
If empty ([code]Rect2(0, 0, 0, 0)[/code]), the whole [member texture] is used.

properties.name: modulate_color
properties.description: Modulates the color of the texture when this style box is drawn.

properties.name: draw_center
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the nine-patch texture's center tile will be drawn.

classes.brief_description: A texture-based nine-patch [StyleBox].
classes.description: A texture-based nine-patch [StyleBox], in a way similar to [NinePatchRect]. This stylebox performs a 3×3 scaling of a texture, where only the center cell is fully stretched. This makes it possible to design bordered styles regardless of the stylebox's size.

classes.name: SubViewport

values.name: CLEAR_MODE_ALWAYS
values.description: Always clear the render target before drawing.

values.name: CLEAR_MODE_NEVER
values.description: Never clear the render target.

values.name: CLEAR_MODE_ONCE
values.description: Clear the render target on the next frame, then switch to [constant CLEAR_MODE_NEVER].

values.name: UPDATE_DISABLED
values.description: Do not update the render target.

values.name: UPDATE_ONCE
values.description: Update the render target once, then switch to [constant UPDATE_DISABLED].

values.name: UPDATE_WHEN_VISIBLE
values.description: Update the render target only when it is visible. This is the default value.

values.name: UPDATE_WHEN_PARENT_VISIBLE
values.description: Update the render target only when its parent is visible.

values.name: UPDATE_ALWAYS
values.description: Always update the render target.

properties.name: size
properties.description:
The width and height of the sub-viewport. Must be set to a value greater than or equal to 2 pixels on both dimensions. Otherwise, nothing will be displayed.
[b]Note:[/b] If the parent node is a [SubViewportContainer] and its [member SubViewportContainer.stretch] is [code]true[/code], the viewport size cannot be changed manually.

properties.name: size_2d_override
properties.description: The 2D size override of the sub-viewport. If either the width or height is [code]0[/code], the override is disabled.

properties.name: size_2d_override_stretch
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], the 2D size override affects stretch as well.

properties.name: view_count
properties.description: The number of view layers we are rendering to. Set this to [code]2[/code] to enable stereo rendering.

properties.name: render_target_clear_mode
properties.description:
The clear mode when the sub-viewport is used as a render target.
[b]Note:[/b] This property is intended for 2D usage.

properties.name: render_target_update_mode
properties.description: The update mode when the sub-viewport is used as a render target.

classes.brief_description: An interface to a game world that doesn't create a window or draw to the screen directly.
classes.description:
[SubViewport] Isolates a rectangular region of a scene to be displayed independently. This can be used, for example, to display UI in 3D space.
[b]Note:[/b] [SubViewport] is a [Viewport] that isn't a [Window], i.e. it doesn't draw anything by itself. To display anything, [SubViewport] must have a non-zero size and be either put inside a [SubViewportContainer] or assigned to a [ViewportTexture].
[b]Note:[/b] [InputEvent]s are not passed to a standalone [SubViewport] by default. To ensure [InputEvent] propagation, a [SubViewport] can be placed inside of a [SubViewportContainer].

classes.name: SubViewportContainer

methods.name: _propagate_input_event
methods.description: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. If it returns [code]true[/code], the [param event] is propagated to [SubViewport] children. Propagation doesn't happen if it returns [code]false[/code]. If the function is not implemented, all events are propagated to SubViewports.

properties.name: stretch
properties.description:
If [code]true[/code], the sub-viewport will be automatically resized to the control's size.
[b]Note:[/b] If [code]true[/code], this will prohibit changing [member SubViewport.size] of its children manually.

properties.name: stretch_shrink
properties.description:
Divides the sub-viewport's effective resolution by this value while preserving its scale. This can be used to speed up rendering.
For example, a 1280×720 sub-viewport with [member stretch_shrink] set to [code]2[/code] will be rendered at 640×360 while occupying the same size in the container.
[b]Note:[/b] [member stretch] must be [code]true[/code] for this property to work.

properties.name: mouse_target
properties.description:
Configure, if either the [SubViewportContainer] or alternatively the [Control] nodes of its [SubViewport] children should be available as targets of mouse-related functionalities, like identifying the drop target in drag-and-drop operations or cursor shape of hovered [Control] node.
If [code]false[/code], the [Control] nodes inside its [SubViewport] children are considered as targets.
If [code]true[/code], the [SubViewportContainer] itself will be considered as a target.

classes.brief_description: A container used for displaying the contents of a [SubViewport].
classes.description:
A container that displays the contents of underlying [SubViewport] child nodes. It uses the combined size of the [SubViewport]s as minimum size, unless [member stretch] is enabled.
[b]Note:[/b] Changing a [SubViewportContainer]'s [member Control.scale] will cause its contents to appear distorted. To change its visual size without causing distortion, adjust the node's margins instead (if it's not already in a container).
[b]Note:[/b] The [SubViewportContainer] forwards mouse-enter and mouse-exit notifications to its sub-viewports.

classes.name: SubtweenTweener

methods.name: set_delay
methods.description: Sets the time in seconds after which the [SubtweenTweener] will start running the subtween. By default there's no delay.

classes.brief_description: Runs a [Tween] nested within another [Tween].
classes.description:
[SubtweenTweener] is used to execute a [Tween] as one step in a sequence defined by another [Tween]. See [method Tween.tween_subtween] for more usage information.
[b]Note:[/b] [method Tween.tween_subtween] is the only correct way to create [SubtweenTweener]. Any [SubtweenTweener] created manually will not function correctly.

classes.name: SurfaceTool

values.name: CUSTOM_RGBA8_UNORM
values.description: Limits range of data passed to [method set_custom] to unsigned normalized 0 to 1 stored in 8 bits per channel. See [constant Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGBA8_UNORM].

values.name: CUSTOM_RGBA8_SNORM
values.description: Limits range of data passed to [method set_custom] to signed normalized -1 to 1 stored in 8 bits per channel. See [constant Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGBA8_SNORM].

values.name: CUSTOM_RG_HALF
values.description: Stores data passed to [method set_custom] as half precision floats, and uses only red and green color channels. See [constant Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RG_HALF].

values.name: CUSTOM_RGBA_HALF
values.description: Stores data passed to [method set_custom] as half precision floats and uses all color channels. See [constant Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGBA_HALF].

values.name: CUSTOM_R_FLOAT
values.description: Stores data passed to [method set_custom] as full precision floats, and uses only red color channel. See [constant Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_R_FLOAT].

values.name: CUSTOM_RG_FLOAT
values.description: Stores data passed to [method set_custom] as full precision floats, and uses only red and green color channels. See [constant Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RG_FLOAT].

values.name: CUSTOM_RGB_FLOAT
values.description: Stores data passed to [method set_custom] as full precision floats, and uses only red, green and blue color channels. See [constant Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGB_FLOAT].

values.name: CUSTOM_RGBA_FLOAT
values.description: Stores data passed to [method set_custom] as full precision floats, and uses all color channels. See [constant Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGBA_FLOAT].

values.name: CUSTOM_MAX
values.description: Used to indicate a disabled custom channel.

values.name: SKIN_4_WEIGHTS
values.description: Each individual vertex can be influenced by only 4 bone weights.

values.name: SKIN_8_WEIGHTS
values.description: Each individual vertex can be influenced by up to 8 bone weights.

methods.name: set_skin_weight_count
methods.description:
Set to [constant SKIN_8_WEIGHTS] to indicate that up to 8 bone influences per vertex may be used.
By default, only 4 bone influences are used ([constant SKIN_4_WEIGHTS]).
[b]Note:[/b] This function takes an enum, not the exact number of weights.

methods.name: get_skin_weight_count
methods.description:
By default, returns [constant SKIN_4_WEIGHTS] to indicate only 4 bone influences per vertex are used.
Returns [constant SKIN_8_WEIGHTS] if up to 8 influences are used.
[b]Note:[/b] This function returns an enum, not the exact number of weights.

methods.name: set_custom_format
methods.description:
Sets the color format for this custom [param channel_index]. Use [constant CUSTOM_MAX] to disable.
Must be invoked after [method begin] and should be set before [method commit] or [method commit_to_arrays].

methods.name: get_custom_format
methods.description: Returns the format for custom [param channel_index] (currently up to 4). Returns [constant CUSTOM_MAX] if this custom channel is unused.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Called before adding any vertices. Takes the primitive type as an argument (e.g. [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES]).

methods.name: add_vertex
methods.description: Specifies the position of current vertex. Should be called after specifying other vertex properties (e.g. Color, UV).

methods.name: set_color
methods.description:
Specifies a [Color] to use for the [i]next[/i] vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.
[b]Note:[/b] The material must have [member BaseMaterial3D.vertex_color_use_as_albedo] enabled for the vertex color to be visible.

methods.name: set_normal
methods.description: Specifies a normal to use for the [i]next[/i] vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

methods.name: set_tangent
methods.description:
Specifies a tangent to use for the [i]next[/i] vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.
[b]Note:[/b] Even though [param tangent] is a [Plane], it does not directly represent the tangent plane. Its [member Plane.x], [member Plane.y], and [member Plane.z] represent the tangent vector and [member Plane.d] should be either [code]-1[/code] or [code]1[/code]. See also [constant Mesh.ARRAY_TANGENT].

methods.name: set_uv
methods.description: Specifies a set of UV coordinates to use for the [i]next[/i] vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

methods.name: set_uv2
methods.description: Specifies an optional second set of UV coordinates to use for the [i]next[/i] vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

methods.name: set_bones
methods.description: Specifies an array of bones to use for the [i]next[/i] vertex. [param bones] must contain 4 integers.

methods.name: set_weights
methods.description: Specifies weight values to use for the [i]next[/i] vertex. [param weights] must contain 4 values. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

methods.name: set_custom
methods.description:
Sets the custom value on this vertex for [param channel_index].
[method set_custom_format] must be called first for this [param channel_index]. Formats which are not RGBA will ignore other color channels.

methods.name: set_smooth_group
methods.description:
Specifies the smooth group to use for the [i]next[/i] vertex. If this is never called, all vertices will have the default smooth group of [code]0[/code] and will be smoothed with adjacent vertices of the same group. To produce a mesh with flat normals, set the smooth group to [code]-1[/code].
[b]Note:[/b] This function actually takes a [code]uint32_t[/code], so C# users should use [code]uint32.MaxValue[/code] instead of [code]-1[/code] to produce a mesh with flat normals.

methods.name: add_triangle_fan
methods.description:
Inserts a triangle fan made of array data into [Mesh] being constructed.
Requires the primitive type be set to [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES].

methods.name: add_index
methods.description: Adds a vertex to index array if you are using indexed vertices. Does not need to be called before adding vertices.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Shrinks the vertex array by creating an index array. This can improve performance by avoiding vertex reuse.

methods.name: deindex
methods.description: Removes the index array by expanding the vertex array.

methods.name: generate_normals
methods.description:
Generates normals from vertices so you do not have to do it manually. If [param flip] is [code]true[/code], the resulting normals will be inverted. [method generate_normals] should be called [i]after[/i] generating geometry and [i]before[/i] committing the mesh using [method commit] or [method commit_to_arrays]. For correct display of normal-mapped surfaces, you will also have to generate tangents using [method generate_tangents].
[b]Note:[/b] [method generate_normals] only works if the primitive type is set to [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES].
[b]Note:[/b] [method generate_normals] takes smooth groups into account. To generate smooth normals, set the smooth group to a value greater than or equal to [code]0[/code] using [method set_smooth_group] or leave the smooth group at the default of [code]0[/code]. To generate flat normals, set the smooth group to [code]-1[/code] using [method set_smooth_group] prior to adding vertices.

methods.name: generate_tangents
methods.description: Generates a tangent vector for each vertex. Requires that each vertex already has UVs and normals set (see [method generate_normals]).

methods.name: optimize_indices_for_cache
methods.description: Optimizes triangle sorting for performance. Requires that [method get_primitive_type] is [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES].

methods.name: get_aabb
methods.description: Returns the axis-aligned bounding box of the vertex positions.

methods.name: generate_lod
methods.description: Generates an LOD for a given [param nd_threshold] in linear units (square root of quadric error metric), using at most [param target_index_count] indices.

methods.name: set_material
methods.description: Sets [Material] to be used by the [Mesh] you are constructing.

methods.name: get_primitive_type
methods.description: Returns the type of mesh geometry, such as [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES].

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear all information passed into the surface tool so far.

methods.name: create_from
methods.description: Creates a vertex array from an existing [Mesh].

methods.name: create_from_arrays
methods.description: Creates this SurfaceTool from existing vertex arrays such as returned by [method commit_to_arrays], [method Mesh.surface_get_arrays], [method Mesh.surface_get_blend_shape_arrays], [method ImporterMesh.get_surface_arrays], and [method ImporterMesh.get_surface_blend_shape_arrays]. [param primitive_type] controls the type of mesh data, defaulting to [constant Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES].

methods.name: create_from_blend_shape
methods.description: Creates a vertex array from the specified blend shape of an existing [Mesh]. This can be used to extract a specific pose from a blend shape.

methods.name: append_from
methods.description: Append vertices from a given [Mesh] surface onto the current vertex array with specified [Transform3D].

methods.name: commit
methods.description:
Returns a constructed [ArrayMesh] from current information passed in. If an existing [ArrayMesh] is passed in as an argument, will add an extra surface to the existing [ArrayMesh].
The [param flags] argument can be the bitwise OR of [constant Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USE_DYNAMIC_UPDATE], [constant Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USE_8_BONE_WEIGHTS], or [constant Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USES_EMPTY_VERTEX_ARRAY].

methods.name: commit_to_arrays
methods.description: Commits the data to the same format used by [method ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays], [method ImporterMesh.add_surface], and [method create_from_arrays]. This way you can further process the mesh data using the [ArrayMesh] or [ImporterMesh] APIs.

classes.brief_description: Helper tool to create geometry.
classes.description:
The [SurfaceTool] is used to construct a [Mesh] by specifying vertex attributes individually. It can be used to construct a [Mesh] from a script. All properties except indices need to be added before calling [method add_vertex]. For example, to add vertex colors and UVs:
[codeblocks]
[gdscript]
var st = SurfaceTool.new()
st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
st.set_color(Color(1, 0, 0))
st.set_uv(Vector2(0, 0))
st.add_vertex(Vector3(0, 0, 0))
[/gdscript]
[csharp]
var st = new SurfaceTool();
st.Begin(Mesh.PrimitiveType.Triangles);
st.SetColor(new Color(1, 0, 0));
st.SetUV(new Vector2(0, 0));
st.AddVertex(new Vector3(0, 0, 0));
[/csharp]
[/codeblocks]
The above [SurfaceTool] now contains one vertex of a triangle which has a UV coordinate and a specified [Color]. If another vertex were added without calling [method set_uv] or [method set_color], then the last values would be used.
Vertex attributes must be passed [b]before[/b] calling [method add_vertex]. Failure to do so will result in an error when committing the vertex information to a mesh.
Additionally, the attributes used before the first vertex is added determine the format of the mesh. For example, if you only add UVs to the first vertex, you cannot add color to any of the subsequent vertices.
See also [ArrayMesh], [ImmediateMesh] and [MeshDataTool] for procedural geometry generation.
[b]Note:[/b] Godot uses clockwise [url=https://learnopengl.com/Advanced-OpenGL/Face-culling]winding order[/url] for front faces of triangle primitive modes.

classes.name: SyntaxHighlighter

methods.name: _get_line_syntax_highlighting
methods.description:
Virtual method which can be overridden to return syntax highlighting data.
See [method get_line_syntax_highlighting] for more details.

methods.name: _clear_highlighting_cache
methods.description: Virtual method which can be overridden to clear any local caches.

methods.name: _update_cache
methods.description: Virtual method which can be overridden to update any local caches.

methods.name: get_line_syntax_highlighting
update_cache
methods.description:
Clears then updates the [SyntaxHighlighter] caches. Override [method _update_cache] for a callback.
[b]Note:[/b] This is called automatically when the associated [TextEdit] node, updates its own cache.

methods.name: clear_highlighting_cache
methods.description:
Clears all cached syntax highlighting data.
Then calls overridable method [method _clear_highlighting_cache].

methods.name: get_text_edit
methods.description: Returns the associated [TextEdit] node.

classes.brief_description: Base class for syntax highlighters. Provides syntax highlighting data to a [TextEdit].
classes.description:
Base class for syntax highlighters. Provides syntax highlighting data to a [TextEdit]. The associated [TextEdit] will call into the [SyntaxHighlighter] on an as-needed basis.
[b]Note:[/b] A [SyntaxHighlighter] instance should not be used across multiple [TextEdit] nodes.

classes.name: SystemFont

properties.name: font_names
properties.description: Array of font family names to search, first matching font found is used.

properties.name: font_italic
properties.description: If set to [code]true[/code], italic or oblique font is preferred.

properties.name: font_weight
properties.description: Preferred weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the [code]100...999[/code] range, normal font weight is [code]400[/code], bold font weight is [code]700[/code].

properties.name: font_stretch
properties.description: Preferred font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between [code]50%[/code] and [code]200%[/code].

properties.name: antialiasing
properties.description: Font anti-aliasing mode.

properties.name: generate_mipmaps
properties.description: If set to [code]true[/code], generate mipmaps for the font textures.

properties.name: disable_embedded_bitmaps
properties.description: If set to [code]true[/code], embedded font bitmap loading is disabled (bitmap-only and color fonts ignore this property).

properties.name: allow_system_fallback
properties.description: If set to [code]true[/code], system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

properties.name: force_autohinter
properties.description: If set to [code]true[/code], auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font built-in hinting.

properties.name: modulate_color_glyphs
properties.description: If set to [code]true[/code], color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs, otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.

properties.name: hinting

Subpixel positioning provides shaper text and better kerning for smaller font sizes, at the cost of memory usage and font rasterization speed. Use [constant TextServer.SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_AUTO] to automatically enable it based on the font size.

properties.name: keep_rounding_remainders

If using font outlines, [member msdf_pixel_range] must be set to at least [i]twice[/i] the size of the largest font outline. The default [member msdf_pixel_range] value of [code]16[/code] allows outline sizes up to [code]8[/code] to look correct.

properties.name: msdf_size

classes.brief_description: A font loaded from a system font. Falls back to a default theme font if not implemented on the host OS.
classes.description:
[SystemFont] loads a font from a system font with the first matching name from [member font_names].
It will attempt to match font style, but it's not guaranteed.
The returned font might be part of a font collection or be a variable font with OpenType "weight", "width" and/or "italic" features set.
You can create [FontVariation] of the system font for precise control over its features.
[b]Note:[/b] This class is implemented on iOS, Linux, macOS and Windows, on other platforms it will fallback to default theme font.

classes.name: TCPServer

methods.name: listen
methods.description:
Listen on the [param port] binding to [param bind_address].
If [param bind_address] is set as [code]"*"[/code] (default), the server will listen on all available addresses (both IPv4 and IPv6).
If [param bind_address] is set as [code]"0.0.0.0"[/code] (for IPv4) or [code]"::"[/code] (for IPv6), the server will listen on all available addresses matching that IP type.
If [param bind_address] is set to any valid address (e.g. [code]"192.168.1.101"[/code], [code]"::1"[/code], etc.), the server will only listen on the interface with that address (or fail if no interface with the given address exists).

methods.description: Returns the local port this server is listening to.

methods.name: take_connection
methods.description: If a connection is available, returns a StreamPeerTCP with the connection.

classes.brief_description: A TCP server.
classes.description:
A TCP server. Listens to connections on a port and returns a [StreamPeerTCP] when it gets an incoming connection.
[b]Note:[/b] When exporting to Android, make sure to enable the [code]INTERNET[/code] permission in the Android export preset before exporting the project or using one-click deploy. Otherwise, network communication of any kind will be blocked by Android.

classes.name: TLSOptions

methods.name: client
methods.description:
Creates a TLS client configuration which validates certificates and their common names (fully qualified domain names).
You can specify a custom [param trusted_chain] of certification authorities (the default CA list will be used if [code]null[/code]), and optionally provide a [param common_name_override] if you expect the certificate to have a common name other than the server FQDN.
[b]Note:[/b] On the Web platform, TLS verification is always enforced against the CA list of the web browser. This is considered a security feature.

methods.name: client_unsafe
methods.description:
Creates an [b]unsafe[/b] TLS client configuration where certificate validation is optional. You can optionally provide a valid [param trusted_chain], but the common name of the certificates will never be checked. Using this configuration for purposes other than testing [b]is not recommended[/b].
[b]Note:[/b] On the Web platform, TLS verification is always enforced against the CA list of the web browser. This is considered a security feature.

methods.name: server
methods.description:
Creates a TLS server configuration using the provided [param key] and [param certificate].
[b]Note:[/b] The [param certificate] should include the full certificate chain up to the signing CA (certificates file can be concatenated using a general purpose text editor).

methods.name: is_server
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if created with [method TLSOptions.server], [code]false[/code] otherwise.

methods.name: is_unsafe_client
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if created with [method TLSOptions.client_unsafe], [code]false[/code] otherwise.

methods.name: get_common_name_override
methods.description: Returns the common name (domain name) override specified when creating with [method TLSOptions.client].

methods.name: get_trusted_ca_chain
methods.description: Returns the CA [X509Certificate] chain specified when creating with [method TLSOptions.client] or [method TLSOptions.client_unsafe].

methods.name: get_private_key
methods.description: Returns the [CryptoKey] specified when creating with [method TLSOptions.server].

methods.name: get_own_certificate
methods.description: Returns the [X509Certificate] specified when creating with [method TLSOptions.server].
