values.description: Line wrapping occurs at the control boundary, beyond what would normally be visible.

values.name: GUTTER_TYPE_STRING
values.description: When a gutter is set to string using [method set_gutter_type], it is used to contain text set via the [method set_line_gutter_text] method.

values.name: GUTTER_TYPE_ICON
values.description: When a gutter is set to icon using [method set_gutter_type], it is used to contain an icon set via the [method set_line_gutter_icon] method.

values.name: GUTTER_TYPE_CUSTOM
values.description: When a gutter is set to custom using [method set_gutter_type], it is used to contain custom visuals controlled by a callback method set via the [method set_gutter_custom_draw] method.

methods.name: _handle_unicode_input
methods.description: Override this method to define what happens when the user types in the provided key [param unicode_char].

methods.name: _backspace
methods.description: Override this method to define what happens when the user presses the backspace key.

methods.name: _cut
methods.description: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a cut operation.

methods.name: _copy
methods.description: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a copy operation.

methods.name: _paste
methods.description: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a paste operation.

methods.name: _paste_primary_clipboard
methods.description:
Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a paste operation with middle mouse button.
[b]Note:[/b] This method is only implemented on Linux.

methods.name: has_ime_text
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user has text in the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Input_method]Input Method Editor[/url] (IME).

methods.name: cancel_ime
methods.description: Closes the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Input_method]Input Method Editor[/url] (IME) if it is open. Any text in the IME will be lost.

methods.name: apply_ime
methods.description: Applies text from the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Input_method]Input Method Editor[/url] (IME) to each caret and closes the IME if it is open.

methods.name: set_tab_size
methods.description: Sets the tab size for the [TextEdit] to use.

methods.name: get_tab_size
methods.description: Returns the [TextEdit]'s' tab size.

methods.name: set_overtype_mode_enabled
methods.description: If [code]true[/code], enables overtype mode. In this mode, typing overrides existing text instead of inserting text. The [member ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_toggle_insert_mode] action toggles overtype mode. See [method is_overtype_mode_enabled].

methods.name: is_overtype_mode_enabled
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if overtype mode is enabled. See [method set_overtype_mode_enabled].

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Performs a full reset of [TextEdit], including undo history.

methods.name: get_line_count
methods.description: Returns the number of lines in the text.

methods.name: set_line
methods.description:
Sets the text for a specific [param line].
Carets on the line will attempt to keep their visual x position.

methods.name: get_line
methods.description: Returns the text of a specific line.

methods.name: get_line_with_ime
methods.description: Returns line text as it is currently displayed, including IME composition string.

methods.name: get_line_width
methods.description: Returns the width in pixels of the [param wrap_index] on [param line].

methods.name: get_line_height
methods.description:
Returns the maximum value of the line height among all lines.
[b]Note:[/b] The return value is influenced by [theme_item line_spacing] and [theme_item font_size]. And it will not be less than [code]1[/code].

methods.name: get_indent_level
methods.description: Returns the indent level of the given line. This is the number of spaces and tabs at the beginning of the line, with the tabs taking the tab size into account (see [method get_tab_size]).

methods.name: get_first_non_whitespace_column
methods.description: Returns the first column containing a non-whitespace character on the given line. If there is only whitespace, returns the number of characters.

methods.name: swap_lines
methods.description: Swaps the two lines. Carets will be swapped with the lines.

methods.name: insert_line_at
methods.description: Inserts a new line with [param text] at [param line].

methods.name: remove_line_at
methods.description:
Removes the line of text at [param line]. Carets on this line will attempt to match their previous visual x position.
If [param move_carets_down] is [code]true[/code] carets will move to the next line down, otherwise carets will move up.

methods.name: insert_text_at_caret
methods.description: Insert the specified text at the caret position.

methods.name: insert_text
methods.description:
Inserts the [param text] at [param line] and [param column].
If [param before_selection_begin] is [code]true[/code], carets and selections that begin at [param line] and [param column] will moved to the end of the inserted text, along with all carets after it.
If [param before_selection_end] is [code]true[/code], selections that end at [param line] and [param column] will be extended to the end of the inserted text. These parameters can be used to insert text inside of or outside of selections.

methods.name: remove_text
methods.description: Removes text between the given positions.

methods.name: get_last_unhidden_line
methods.description: Returns the last unhidden line in the entire [TextEdit].

methods.name: get_next_visible_line_offset_from
methods.description: Returns the count to the next visible line from [param line] to [code]line + visible_amount[/code]. Can also count backwards. For example if a [TextEdit] has 5 lines with lines 2 and 3 hidden, calling this with [code]line = 1, visible_amount = 1[/code] would return 3.

methods.name: get_next_visible_line_index_offset_from
methods.description: Similar to [method get_next_visible_line_offset_from], but takes into account the line wrap indexes. In the returned vector, [code]x[/code] is the line, [code]y[/code] is the wrap index.

methods.name: backspace
methods.description: Called when the user presses the backspace key. Can be overridden with [method _backspace].

methods.name: cut
methods.description: Cut's the current selection. Can be overridden with [method _cut].

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies the current text selection. Can be overridden with [method _copy].

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Paste at the current location. Can be overridden with [method _paste].

methods.name: paste_primary_clipboard
methods.description: Pastes the primary clipboard.

methods.name: start_action
methods.description:
Starts an action, will end the current action if [param action] is different.
An action will also end after a call to [method end_action], after [member ProjectSettings.gui/timers/text_edit_idle_detect_sec] is triggered or a new undoable step outside the [method start_action] and [method end_action] calls.

methods.name: end_action
methods.description: Marks the end of steps in the current action started with [method start_action].

methods.name: begin_complex_operation
methods.description: Starts a multipart edit. All edits will be treated as one action until [method end_complex_operation] is called.

methods.name: end_complex_operation
methods.description: Ends a multipart edit, started with [method begin_complex_operation]. If called outside a complex operation, the current operation is pushed onto the undo/redo stack.

methods.name: has_undo
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an "undo" action is available.

methods.name: has_redo
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a "redo" action is available.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Perform undo operation.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Perform redo operation.

methods.name: clear_undo_history
methods.description: Clears the undo history.

methods.name: tag_saved_version
methods.description: Tag the current version as saved.

methods.name: get_version
methods.description: Returns the current version of the [TextEdit]. The version is a count of recorded operations by the undo/redo history.

methods.name: get_saved_version
methods.description: Returns the last tagged saved version from [method tag_saved_version].

methods.name: set_search_text
methods.description: Sets the search text. See [method set_search_flags].

methods.name: set_search_flags
methods.description: Sets the search [param flags]. This is used with [method set_search_text] to highlight occurrences of the searched text. Search flags can be specified from the [enum SearchFlags] enum.

methods.name: search
set_tooltip_request_func
methods.description: Provide custom tooltip text. The callback method must take the following args: [code]hovered_word: String[/code].

methods.name: get_local_mouse_pos
methods.description: Returns the local mouse position adjusted for the text direction.

methods.name: get_word_at_pos
methods.description: Returns the word at [param position].

methods.name: get_line_column_at_pos
methods.description:
Returns the line and column at the given position. In the returned vector, [code]x[/code] is the column and [code]y[/code] is the line.
If [param clamp_line] is [code]false[/code] and [param position] is below the last line, [code]Vector2i(-1, -1)[/code] is returned.
If [param clamp_column] is [code]false[/code] and [param position] is outside the column range of the line, [code]Vector2i(-1, -1)[/code] is returned.

methods.name: get_pos_at_line_column
methods.description:
Returns the local position for the given [param line] and [param column]. If [code]x[/code] or [code]y[/code] of the returned vector equal [code]-1[/code], the position is outside of the viewable area of the control.
[b]Note:[/b] The Y position corresponds to the bottom side of the line. Use [method get_rect_at_line_column] to get the top side position.

methods.name: get_rect_at_line_column
methods.description:
Returns the local position and size for the grapheme at the given [param line] and [param column]. If [code]x[/code] or [code]y[/code] position of the returned rect equal [code]-1[/code], the position is outside of the viewable area of the control.
[b]Note:[/b] The Y position of the returned rect corresponds to the top side of the line, unlike [method get_pos_at_line_column] which returns the bottom side.

methods.name: get_minimap_line_at_pos
methods.description: Returns the equivalent minimap line at [param position].

methods.name: is_dragging_cursor
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user is dragging their mouse for scrolling, selecting, or text dragging.

methods.name: is_mouse_over_selection
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the mouse is over a selection. If [param edges] is [code]true[/code], the edges are considered part of the selection.

methods.name: add_caret
methods.description: Adds a new caret at the given location. Returns the index of the new caret, or [code]-1[/code] if the location is invalid.

methods.name: remove_caret
methods.description:
Removes the given caret index.
[b]Note:[/b] This can result in adjustment of all other caret indices.

methods.name: remove_secondary_carets
methods.description: Removes all additional carets.

methods.name: get_caret_count
methods.description: Returns the number of carets in this [TextEdit].

methods.name: add_caret_at_carets
methods.description: Adds an additional caret above or below every caret. If [param below] is [code]true[/code] the new caret will be added below and above otherwise.

methods.name: get_sorted_carets
methods.description:
Returns the carets sorted by selection beginning from lowest line and column to highest (from top to bottom of text).
If [param include_ignored_carets] is [code]false[/code], carets from [method multicaret_edit_ignore_caret] will be ignored.

methods.name: collapse_carets
methods.description:
Collapse all carets in the given range to the [param from_line] and [param from_column] position.
[param inclusive] applies to both ends.
If [method is_in_mulitcaret_edit] is [code]true[/code], carets that are collapsed will be [code]true[/code] for [method multicaret_edit_ignore_caret].
[method merge_overlapping_carets] will be called if any carets were collapsed.

methods.name: merge_overlapping_carets
methods.description:
Merges any overlapping carets. Will favor the newest caret, or the caret with a selection.
If [method is_in_mulitcaret_edit] is [code]true[/code], the merge will be queued to happen at the end of the multicaret edit. See [method begin_multicaret_edit] and [method end_multicaret_edit].
[b]Note:[/b] This is not called when a caret changes position but after certain actions, so it is possible to get into a state where carets overlap.

methods.name: begin_multicaret_edit
methods.description:
Starts an edit for multiple carets. The edit must be ended with [method end_multicaret_edit]. Multicaret edits can be used to edit text at multiple carets and delay merging the carets until the end, so the caret indexes aren't affected immediately. [method begin_multicaret_edit] and [method end_multicaret_edit] can be nested, and the merge will happen at the last [method end_multicaret_edit].
[codeblock]
begin_complex_operation()
begin_multicaret_edit()
for i in range(get_caret_count()):
	if multicaret_edit_ignore_caret(i):
		continue
	# Logic here.
end_multicaret_edit()
end_complex_operation()
[/codeblock]

methods.name: end_multicaret_edit
methods.description: Ends an edit for multiple carets, that was started with [method begin_multicaret_edit]. If this was the last [method end_multicaret_edit] and [method merge_overlapping_carets] was called, carets will be merged.

methods.name: is_in_mulitcaret_edit
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a [method begin_multicaret_edit] has been called and [method end_multicaret_edit] has not yet been called.

methods.name: multicaret_edit_ignore_caret
methods.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if the given [param caret_index] should be ignored as part of a multicaret edit. See [method begin_multicaret_edit] and [method end_multicaret_edit]. Carets that should be ignored are ones that were part of removed text and will likely be merged at the end of the edit, or carets that were added during the edit.
It is recommended to [code]continue[/code] within a loop iterating on multiple carets if a caret should be ignored.

methods.name: is_caret_visible
methods.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if the caret is visible, [code]false[/code] otherwise. A caret will be considered hidden if it is outside the scrollable area when scrolling is enabled.
[b]Note:[/b] [method is_caret_visible] does not account for a caret being off-screen if it is still within the scrollable area. It will return [code]true[/code] even if the caret is off-screen as long as it meets [TextEdit]'s own conditions for being visible. This includes uses of [member scroll_fit_content_width] and [member scroll_fit_content_height] that cause the [TextEdit] to expand beyond the viewport's bounds.
[b]Note:[/b] This method does [i]not[/i] guarantee an accurate visibility check immediately after setting the caret position. The correct value may only be available in the next frame after the [TextEdit] has finished drawing. This also applies to any operation that causes the [TextEdit] to change in size.

methods.name: get_caret_draw_pos
methods.description: Returns the caret pixel draw position.

methods.name: set_caret_line
methods.description:
Moves the caret to the specified [param line] index. The caret column will be moved to the same visual position it was at the last time [method set_caret_column] was called, or clamped to the end of the line.
If [param adjust_viewport] is [code]true[/code], the viewport will center at the caret position after the move occurs.
If [param can_be_hidden] is [code]true[/code], the specified [param line] can be hidden.
If [param wrap_index] is [code]-1[/code], the caret column will be clamped to the [param line]'s length. If [param wrap_index] is greater than [code]-1[/code], the column will be moved to attempt to match the visual x position on the line's [param wrap_index] to the position from the last time [method set_caret_column] was called.
[b]Note:[/b] If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See [method merge_overlapping_carets].

methods.name: get_caret_line
methods.description: Returns the line the editing caret is on.

methods.name: set_caret_column
methods.description:
Moves the caret to the specified [param column] index.
If [param adjust_viewport] is [code]true[/code], the viewport will center at the caret position after the move occurs.
[b]Note:[/b] If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See [method merge_overlapping_carets].

methods.name: get_caret_column
methods.description: Returns the column the editing caret is at.

methods.name: get_next_composite_character_column
methods.description:
Returns the correct column at the end of a composite character like ❤️‍🩹 (mending heart; Unicode: [code]U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79[/code]) which is comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the start of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with the caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters.
[b]Note:[/b] To check at caret location use [code]get_next_composite_character_column(get_caret_line(), get_caret_column())[/code]

methods.name: get_previous_composite_character_column
methods.description:
Returns the correct column at the start of a composite character like ❤️‍🩹 (mending heart; Unicode: [code]U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79[/code]) which is comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the end of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with the caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters.
[b]Note:[/b] To check at caret location use [code]get_previous_composite_character_column(get_caret_line(), get_caret_column())[/code]

methods.name: get_caret_wrap_index
methods.description: Returns the wrap index the editing caret is on.

methods.name: get_word_under_caret
methods.description: Returns a [String] text with the word under the caret's location.

methods.name: set_selection_mode
methods.description: Sets the current selection mode.

methods.name: get_selection_mode
methods.description: Returns the current selection mode.

methods.name: select_all
methods.description:
Select all the text.
If [member selecting_enabled] is [code]false[/code], no selection will occur.

methods.name: select_word_under_caret
methods.description: Selects the word under the caret.

methods.name: add_selection_for_next_occurrence
methods.description: Adds a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current selection. If there is no active selection, selects word under caret.

methods.name: skip_selection_for_next_occurrence
methods.description: Moves a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current selection. If there is no active selection, moves to the next occurrence of the word under caret.

methods.name: select
methods.description:
Selects text from [param origin_line] and [param origin_column] to [param caret_line] and [param caret_column] for the given [param caret_index]. This moves the selection origin and the caret. If the positions are the same, the selection will be deselected.
If [member selecting_enabled] is [code]false[/code], no selection will occur.
[b]Note:[/b] If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See [method merge_overlapping_carets].

methods.name: has_selection
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user has selected text.

methods.name: get_selected_text
methods.description: Returns the text inside the selection of a caret, or all the carets if [param caret_index] is its default value [code]-1[/code].

methods.name: get_selection_at_line_column
methods.description:
Returns the caret index of the selection at the given [param line] and [param column], or [code]-1[/code] if there is none.
If [param include_edges] is [code]false[/code], the position must be inside the selection and not at either end. If [param only_selections] is [code]false[/code], carets without a selection will also be considered.

methods.name: get_line_ranges_from_carets
methods.description:
Returns an [Array] of line ranges where [code]x[/code] is the first line and [code]y[/code] is the last line. All lines within these ranges will have a caret on them or be part of a selection. Each line will only be part of one line range, even if it has multiple carets on it.
If a selection's end column ([method get_selection_to_column]) is at column [code]0[/code], that line will not be included. If a selection begins on the line after another selection ends and [param merge_adjacent] is [code]true[/code], or they begin and end on the same line, one line range will include both selections.

methods.name: get_selection_origin_line
methods.description: Returns the origin line of the selection. This is the opposite end from the caret.

methods.name: get_selection_origin_column
methods.description: Returns the origin column of the selection. This is the opposite end from the caret.

methods.name: set_selection_origin_line
methods.description:
Sets the selection origin line to the [param line] for the given [param caret_index]. If the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the selection will deselect.
If [param can_be_hidden] is [code]false[/code], The line will be set to the nearest unhidden line below or above.
If [param wrap_index] is [code]-1[/code], the selection origin column will be clamped to the [param line]'s length. If [param wrap_index] is greater than [code]-1[/code], the column will be moved to attempt to match the visual x position on the line's [param wrap_index] to the position from the last time [method set_selection_origin_column] or [method select] was called.

methods.name: set_selection_origin_column
methods.description: Sets the selection origin column to the [param column] for the given [param caret_index]. If the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the selection will deselect.

methods.name: get_selection_from_line
methods.description: Returns the selection begin line. Returns the caret line if there is no selection.

methods.name: get_selection_from_column
methods.description: Returns the selection begin column. Returns the caret column if there is no selection.

methods.name: get_selection_to_line
methods.description: Returns the selection end line. Returns the caret line if there is no selection.

methods.name: get_selection_to_column
methods.description: Returns the selection end column. Returns the caret column if there is no selection.

methods.name: is_caret_after_selection_origin
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the caret of the selection is after the selection origin. This can be used to determine the direction of the selection.

methods.name: deselect
methods.description: Deselects the current selection.

methods.name: delete_selection
methods.description: Deletes the selected text.

methods.name: is_line_wrapped
methods.description: Returns if the given line is wrapped.

methods.name: get_line_wrap_count
methods.description: Returns the number of times the given line is wrapped.

methods.name: get_line_wrap_index_at_column
methods.description: Returns the wrap index of the given column on the given line. This ranges from [code]0[/code] to [method get_line_wrap_count].

methods.name: get_line_wrapped_text
methods.description: Returns an array of [String]s representing each wrapped index.

methods.name: get_v_scroll_bar
methods.description: Returns the [VScrollBar] of the [TextEdit].

methods.name: get_h_scroll_bar
methods.description: Returns the [HScrollBar] used by [TextEdit].

methods.name: get_scroll_pos_for_line
methods.description: Returns the scroll position for [param wrap_index] of [param line].

methods.name: set_line_as_first_visible
methods.description: Positions the [param wrap_index] of [param line] at the top of the viewport.

methods.name: get_first_visible_line
methods.description: Returns the first visible line.

methods.name: is_line_in_viewport
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given line is within the scope of the scrollable area of the viewport.

methods.name: set_line_as_center_visible
methods.description: Positions the [param wrap_index] of [param line] at the center of the viewport.

methods.name: set_line_as_last_visible
methods.description: Positions the [param wrap_index] of [param line] at the bottom of the viewport.

methods.name: get_last_full_visible_line
methods.description: Returns the last visible line. Use [method get_last_full_visible_line_wrap_index] for the wrap index.

methods.name: get_last_full_visible_line_wrap_index
methods.description: Returns the last visible wrap index of the last visible line.

methods.name: get_visible_line_count
methods.description: Returns the number of lines that can visually fit, rounded down, based on this control's height.

methods.name: get_visible_line_count_in_range
methods.description: Returns the total number of lines between [param from_line] and [param to_line] (inclusive) in the text. This includes wrapped lines and excludes folded lines. If the range covers all lines it is equivalent to [method get_total_visible_line_count].

methods.name: get_total_visible_line_count
methods.description: Returns the total number of lines in the text. This includes wrapped lines and excludes folded lines. If [member wrap_mode] is set to [constant LINE_WRAPPING_NONE] and no lines are folded (see [method CodeEdit.is_line_folded]) then this is equivalent to [method get_line_count]. See [method get_visible_line_count_in_range] for a limited range of lines.

methods.name: adjust_viewport_to_caret
methods.description: Adjust the viewport so the caret is visible.

methods.name: center_viewport_to_caret
methods.description: Centers the viewport on the line the editing caret is at. This also resets the [member scroll_horizontal] value to [code]0[/code].

methods.name: get_minimap_visible_lines
methods.description: Returns the number of lines that may be drawn on the minimap.

methods.name: add_gutter
methods.description: Register a new gutter to this [TextEdit]. Use [param at] to have a specific gutter order. A value of [code]-1[/code] appends the gutter to the right.

methods.name: remove_gutter
methods.description: Removes the gutter at the given index.

methods.name: get_gutter_count
methods.description: Returns the number of gutters registered.

methods.name: set_gutter_name
methods.description: Sets the name of the gutter at the given index.

methods.name: get_gutter_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the gutter at the given index.

methods.name: set_gutter_type
methods.description: Sets the type of gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain icons, text, or custom visuals.

methods.name: get_gutter_type
methods.description: Returns the type of the gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain icons, text, or custom visuals.

methods.name: set_gutter_width
methods.description: Set the width of the gutter at the given index.

methods.name: get_gutter_width
methods.description: Returns the width of the gutter at the given index.

methods.name: set_gutter_draw
methods.description: If [code]true[/code], the gutter at the given index is drawn. The gutter type ([method set_gutter_type]) determines how it is drawn. See [method is_gutter_drawn].

methods.name: is_gutter_drawn
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the gutter at the given index is currently drawn. See [method set_gutter_draw].

methods.name: set_gutter_clickable
methods.description: If [code]true[/code], the mouse cursor will change to a pointing hand ([constant Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND]) when hovering over the gutter at the given index. See [method is_gutter_clickable] and [method set_line_gutter_clickable].

methods.name: is_gutter_clickable
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the gutter at the given index is clickable. See [method set_gutter_clickable].

methods.name: set_gutter_overwritable
methods.description: If [code]true[/code], the line data of the gutter at the given index can be overridden when using [method merge_gutters]. See [method is_gutter_overwritable].

methods.name: is_gutter_overwritable
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the gutter at the given index is overwritable. See [method set_gutter_overwritable].

methods.name: merge_gutters
methods.description: Merge the gutters from [param from_line] into [param to_line]. Only overwritable gutters will be copied. See [method set_gutter_overwritable].

methods.name: set_gutter_custom_draw

classes.brief_description: A multiline text editor.
classes.description:
A multiline text editor. It also has limited facilities for editing code, such as syntax highlighting support. For more advanced facilities for editing code, see [CodeEdit].
While entering text, it is possible to insert special characters using Unicode, OEM or Windows alt codes:
- To enter Unicode codepoints, hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type the codepoint on the numpad. For example, to enter the character [code]á[/code] (U+00E1), hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type [kbd]+E1[/kbd] on the numpad (the leading zeroes can be omitted).
- To enter OEM codepoints, hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type the code on the numpad. For example, to enter the character [code]á[/code] (OEM 160), hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type [code]160[/code] on the numpad.
- To enter Windows codepoints, hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type the code on the numpad. For example, to enter the character [code]á[/code] (Windows 0225), hold [kbd]Alt[/kbd] and type [kbd]0[/kbd], [kbd]2[/kbd], [kbd]2[/kbd], [kbd]5[/kbd] on the numpad. The leading zero here must [b]not[/b] be omitted, as this is how Windows codepoints are distinguished from OEM codepoints.
[b]Note:[/b] Most viewport, caret, and edit methods contain a [code]caret_index[/code] argument for [member caret_multiple] support. The argument should be one of the following: [code]-1[/code] for all carets, [code]0[/code] for the main caret, or greater than [code]0[/code] for secondary carets in the order they were created.
[b]Note:[/b] When holding down [kbd]Alt[/kbd], the vertical scroll wheel will scroll 5 times as fast as it would normally do. This also works in the Godot script editor.

properties.name: text
properties.description:
The text to generate mesh from.
[b]Note:[/b] Due to being a [Resource], it doesn't follow the rules of [member Node.auto_translate_mode]. If disabling translation is desired, it should be done manually with [method Object.set_message_translation].

properties.name: font
properties.description: Font configuration used to display text.

properties.name: font_size
properties.description:
Font size of the [TextMesh]'s text. This property works in tandem with [member pixel_size]. Higher values will result in a more detailed font, regardless of [member curve_step] and [member pixel_size]. Consider keeping this value below 63 (inclusive) for good performance, and adjust [member pixel_size] as needed to enlarge text.
[b]Note:[/b] Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation, especially with large font sizes and long texts. To change the text's size in real-time efficiently, change the node's [member Node3D.scale] instead.

properties.name: horizontal_alignment
properties.description: Controls the text's horizontal alignment. Supports left, center, right, and fill (also known as justify).

properties.name: vertical_alignment
properties.description: Controls the text's vertical alignment. Supports top, center, and bottom.

properties.name: uppercase
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], all the text displays as UPPERCASE.

properties.name: line_spacing
properties.description: Additional vertical spacing between lines (in pixels), spacing is added to line descent. This value can be negative.

properties.name: autowrap_mode
properties.description: If set to something other than [constant TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF], the text gets wrapped inside the node's bounding rectangle. If you resize the node, it will change its height automatically to show all the text.

properties.name: justification_flags
properties.description: Line fill alignment rules.

properties.name: pixel_size
properties.description:
The size of one pixel's width on the text to scale it in 3D. This property works in tandem with [member font_size].
[b]Note:[/b] Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation, especially with large font sizes and long texts. To change the text's size in real-time efficiently, change the node's [member Node3D.scale] instead.

properties.name: curve_step
properties.description:
Step (in pixels) used to approximate Bézier curves. Lower values result in smoother curves, but is slower to generate and render. Consider adjusting this according to the font size and the typical viewing distance.
[b]Note:[/b] Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation, especially with large font sizes and long texts.

properties.name: depth
properties.description: Depths of the mesh, if set to [code]0.0[/code] only front surface, is generated, and UV layout is changed to use full texture for the front face only.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Text width (in pixels), used for fill alignment.

properties.name: offset
properties.description:
The text drawing offset (in pixels).
[b]Note:[/b] Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation. To change the text's position in real-time efficiently, change the node's [member Node3D.position] instead.

properties.description: Base text writing direction.

properties.description: Language code used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If left empty, the current locale is used instead.

classes.brief_description: Generate a [PrimitiveMesh] from the text.
classes.description:
Generate a [PrimitiveMesh] from the text.
TextMesh can be generated only when using dynamic fonts with vector glyph contours. Bitmap fonts (including bitmap data in the TrueType/OpenType containers, like color emoji fonts) are not supported.
The UV layout is arranged in 4 horizontal strips, top to bottom: 40% of the height for the front face, 40% for the back face, 10% for the outer edges and 10% for the inner edges.

values.name: FONT_ANTIALIASING_GRAY
values.description: Font glyphs are rasterized as 8-bit grayscale anti-aliased bitmaps.

values.name: FONT_ANTIALIASING_LCD
values.description:
Font glyphs are rasterized for LCD screens.
LCD subpixel layout is determined by the value of the [member ProjectSettings.gui/theme/lcd_subpixel_layout] setting.
LCD subpixel anti-aliasing mode is suitable only for rendering horizontal, unscaled text in 2D.

values.name: FONT_LCD_SUBPIXEL_LAYOUT_NONE
values.description: Unknown or unsupported subpixel layout, LCD subpixel antialiasing is disabled.

values.name: FONT_LCD_SUBPIXEL_LAYOUT_HRGB
values.description: Horizontal RGB subpixel layout.

values.name: FONT_LCD_SUBPIXEL_LAYOUT_HBGR
values.description: Horizontal BGR subpixel layout.

values.name: FONT_LCD_SUBPIXEL_LAYOUT_VRGB
values.description: Vertical RGB subpixel layout.

values.name: FONT_LCD_SUBPIXEL_LAYOUT_VBGR
values.description: Vertical BGR subpixel layout.

values.name: FONT_LCD_SUBPIXEL_LAYOUT_MAX
values.description: Represents the size of the [enum FontLCDSubpixelLayout] enum.

values.name: DIRECTION_AUTO
values.description: Text direction is determined based on contents and current locale.

values.name: DIRECTION_LTR
values.description: Text is written from left to right.

values.name: DIRECTION_RTL
values.description: Text is written from right to left.

values.name: DIRECTION_INHERITED
values.description: Text writing direction is the same as base string writing direction. Used for BiDi override only.

values.name: ORIENTATION_HORIZONTAL
values.description: Text is written horizontally.

values.name: ORIENTATION_VERTICAL
values.description:
Left to right text is written vertically from top to bottom.
Right to left text is written vertically from bottom to top.

values.name: JUSTIFICATION_NONE
values.description: Do not justify text.

values.name: JUSTIFICATION_KASHIDA
values.description: Justify text by adding and removing kashidas.

values.name: JUSTIFICATION_WORD_BOUND
values.description: Justify text by changing width of the spaces between the words.

values.name: JUSTIFICATION_TRIM_EDGE_SPACES
values.description: Remove trailing and leading spaces from the justified text.

values.name: JUSTIFICATION_AFTER_LAST_TAB
values.description: Only apply justification to the part of the text after the last tab.

values.name: JUSTIFICATION_CONSTRAIN_ELLIPSIS
values.description: Apply justification to the trimmed line with ellipsis.

values.name: JUSTIFICATION_SKIP_LAST_LINE
values.description: Do not apply justification to the last line of the paragraph.

values.name: JUSTIFICATION_SKIP_LAST_LINE_WITH_VISIBLE_CHARS
values.description: Do not apply justification to the last line of the paragraph with visible characters (takes precedence over [constant JUSTIFICATION_SKIP_LAST_LINE]).

values.name: JUSTIFICATION_DO_NOT_SKIP_SINGLE_LINE
values.description: Always apply justification to the paragraphs with a single line ([constant JUSTIFICATION_SKIP_LAST_LINE] and [constant JUSTIFICATION_SKIP_LAST_LINE_WITH_VISIBLE_CHARS] are ignored).

values.name: AUTOWRAP_OFF
values.description: Autowrap is disabled.

values.name: AUTOWRAP_ARBITRARY
values.description: Wraps the text inside the node's bounding rectangle by allowing to break lines at arbitrary positions, which is useful when very limited space is available.

values.name: AUTOWRAP_WORD
values.description: Wraps the text inside the node's bounding rectangle by soft-breaking between words.

values.name: AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
values.description: Behaves similarly to [constant AUTOWRAP_WORD], but force-breaks a word if that single word does not fit in one line.

values.name: BREAK_NONE
values.description: Do not break the line.

values.name: BREAK_MANDATORY
values.description: Break the line at the line mandatory break characters (e.g. [code]"\n"[/code]).

values.name: BREAK_WORD_BOUND
values.description: Break the line between the words.

values.name: BREAK_GRAPHEME_BOUND
values.description: Break the line between any unconnected graphemes.

values.name: BREAK_ADAPTIVE
values.description: Should be used only in conjunction with [constant BREAK_WORD_BOUND], break the line between any unconnected graphemes, if it's impossible to break it between the words.

values.name: BREAK_TRIM_EDGE_SPACES
values.description: Remove edge spaces from the broken line segments.

values.name: BREAK_TRIM_INDENT
values.description: Subtract first line indentation width from all lines after the first one.

values.name: BREAK_TRIM_START_EDGE_SPACES
values.description:
Remove spaces and line break characters from the start of broken line segments.
E.g, after line breaking, the second segment of the following text [code]test  \n  next[/code], is [code]next[/code] if the flag is set, and [code]  next[/code] if it is not.

values.name: BREAK_TRIM_END_EDGE_SPACES
values.description:
Remove spaces and line break characters from the end of broken line segments.
E.g, after line breaking, the first segment of the following text [code]test  \n  next[/code], is [code]test[/code] if the flag is set, and [code]test  \n[/code] if it is not.

values.name: VC_CHARS_BEFORE_SHAPING
values.description:
Trims text before the shaping. e.g, increasing [member Label.visible_characters] or [member RichTextLabel.visible_characters] value is visually identical to typing the text.
[b]Note:[/b] In this mode, trimmed text is not processed at all. It is not accounted for in line breaking and size calculations.

values.name: VC_CHARS_AFTER_SHAPING
values.description: Displays glyphs that are mapped to the first [member Label.visible_characters] or [member RichTextLabel.visible_characters] characters from the beginning of the text.

values.name: VC_GLYPHS_AUTO
values.description: Displays [member Label.visible_ratio] or [member RichTextLabel.visible_ratio] glyphs, starting from the left or from the right, depending on [member Control.layout_direction] value.

values.name: VC_GLYPHS_LTR
values.description: Displays [member Label.visible_ratio] or [member RichTextLabel.visible_ratio] glyphs, starting from the left.

values.name: VC_GLYPHS_RTL
values.description: Displays [member Label.visible_ratio] or [member RichTextLabel.visible_ratio] glyphs, starting from the right.

values.name: OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING
values.description: No text trimming is performed.

values.name: OVERRUN_TRIM_CHAR
values.description: Trims the text per character.

values.name: OVERRUN_TRIM_WORD
values.description: Trims the text per word.

values.name: OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
values.description: Trims the text per character and adds an ellipsis to indicate that parts are hidden if trimmed text is 6 characters or longer.

values.name: OVERRUN_TRIM_WORD_ELLIPSIS
values.description: Trims the text per word and adds an ellipsis to indicate that parts are hidden if trimmed text is 6 characters or longer.

values.name: OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS_FORCE
values.description: Trims the text per character and adds an ellipsis to indicate that parts are hidden regardless of trimmed text length.

values.name: OVERRUN_TRIM_WORD_ELLIPSIS_FORCE
values.description: Trims the text per word and adds an ellipsis to indicate that parts are hidden regardless of trimmed text length.

values.name: OVERRUN_NO_TRIM
values.description: No trimming is performed.

values.name: OVERRUN_TRIM
values.description: Trims the text when it exceeds the given width.

values.name: OVERRUN_TRIM_WORD_ONLY
values.description: Trims the text per word instead of per grapheme.

values.name: OVERRUN_ADD_ELLIPSIS
values.description: Determines whether an ellipsis should be added at the end of the text.

values.name: OVERRUN_ENFORCE_ELLIPSIS
values.description: Determines whether the ellipsis at the end of the text is enforced and may not be hidden.

values.name: OVERRUN_JUSTIFICATION_AWARE
values.description: Accounts for the text being justified before attempting to trim it (see [enum JustificationFlag]).

values.name: OVERRUN_SHORT_STRING_ELLIPSIS
values.description: Determines whether the ellipsis should be added regardless of the string length, otherwise it is added only if the string is 6 characters or longer.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_VALID
values.description: Grapheme is supported by the font, and can be drawn.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_RTL
values.description: Grapheme is part of right-to-left or bottom-to-top run.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_VIRTUAL
values.description: Grapheme is not part of source text, it was added by justification process.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_SPACE
values.description: Grapheme is whitespace.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_BREAK_HARD
values.description: Grapheme is mandatory break point (e.g. [code]"\n"[/code]).

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_BREAK_SOFT
values.description: Grapheme is optional break point (e.g. space).

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_TAB
values.description: Grapheme is the tabulation character.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_ELONGATION
values.description: Grapheme is kashida.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_PUNCTUATION
values.description: Grapheme is punctuation character.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_UNDERSCORE
values.description: Grapheme is underscore character.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_CONNECTED
values.description: Grapheme is connected to the previous grapheme. Breaking line before this grapheme is not safe.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_SAFE_TO_INSERT_TATWEEL
values.description: It is safe to insert a U+0640 before this grapheme for elongation.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_EMBEDDED_OBJECT
values.description: Grapheme is an object replacement character for the embedded object.

values.name: GRAPHEME_IS_SOFT_HYPHEN
values.description: Grapheme is a soft hyphen.

values.name: HINTING_NONE
values.description: Disables font hinting (smoother but less crisp).

values.name: HINTING_LIGHT
values.description: Use the light font hinting mode.

values.name: HINTING_NORMAL
values.description:
Use the default font hinting mode (crisper but less smooth).
[b]Note:[/b] This hinting mode changes both horizontal and vertical glyph metrics. If applied to monospace font, some glyphs might have different width.

values.name: SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_DISABLED
values.description: Glyph horizontal position is rounded to the whole pixel size, each glyph is rasterized once.

values.name: SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_AUTO
values.description:
Glyph horizontal position is rounded based on font size.
- To one quarter of the pixel size if font size is smaller or equal to [constant SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_ONE_QUARTER_MAX_SIZE].
- To one half of the pixel size if font size is smaller or equal to [constant SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_ONE_HALF_MAX_SIZE].
- To the whole pixel size for larger fonts.

values.name: SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_ONE_HALF
values.description: Glyph horizontal position is rounded to one half of the pixel size, each glyph is rasterized up to two times.

values.name: SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_ONE_QUARTER
values.description: Glyph horizontal position is rounded to one quarter of the pixel size, each glyph is rasterized up to four times.

values.name: SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_ONE_HALF_MAX_SIZE
values.description: Maximum font size which will use "one half of the pixel" subpixel positioning in [constant SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_AUTO] mode.

values.name: SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_ONE_QUARTER_MAX_SIZE
values.description: Maximum font size which will use "one quarter of the pixel" subpixel positioning in [constant SUBPIXEL_POSITIONING_AUTO] mode.

values.name: FEATURE_SIMPLE_LAYOUT
values.description: TextServer supports simple text layouts.

values.name: FEATURE_BIDI_LAYOUT
values.description: TextServer supports bidirectional text layouts.

values.name: FEATURE_VERTICAL_LAYOUT
values.description: TextServer supports vertical layouts.

values.name: FEATURE_SHAPING
values.description: TextServer supports complex text shaping.

values.name: FEATURE_KASHIDA_JUSTIFICATION
values.description: TextServer supports justification using kashidas.

values.name: FEATURE_BREAK_ITERATORS
values.description: TextServer supports complex line/word breaking rules (e.g. dictionary based).

values.name: FEATURE_FONT_BITMAP
values.description: TextServer supports loading bitmap fonts.

values.name: FEATURE_FONT_DYNAMIC
values.description: TextServer supports loading dynamic (TrueType, OpeType, etc.) fonts.

values.name: FEATURE_FONT_MSDF
values.description: TextServer supports multichannel signed distance field dynamic font rendering.

values.name: FEATURE_FONT_SYSTEM
values.description: TextServer supports loading system fonts.

values.name: FEATURE_FONT_VARIABLE
values.description: TextServer supports variable fonts.

values.name: FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CASE_CONVERSION
values.description: TextServer supports locale dependent and context sensitive case conversion.

values.name: FEATURE_USE_SUPPORT_DATA
values.description: TextServer require external data file for some features, see [method load_support_data].

values.name: FEATURE_UNICODE_IDENTIFIERS
values.description: TextServer supports UAX #31 identifier validation, see [method is_valid_identifier].

values.name: FEATURE_UNICODE_SECURITY
values.description: TextServer supports [url=https://unicode.org/reports/tr36/]Unicode Technical Report #36[/url] and [url=https://unicode.org/reports/tr39/]Unicode Technical Standard #39[/url] based spoof detection features.

values.name: CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON
values.description: Contour point is on the curve.

values.name: CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CONIC
values.description: Contour point isn't on the curve, but serves as a control point for a conic (quadratic) Bézier arc.

values.name: CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CUBIC
values.description: Contour point isn't on the curve, but serves as a control point for a cubic Bézier arc.

values.name: SPACING_GLYPH
values.description: Spacing for each glyph.

values.name: SPACING_SPACE
values.description: Spacing for the space character.

values.name: SPACING_TOP
values.description: Spacing at the top of the line.

values.name: SPACING_BOTTOM
values.description: Spacing at the bottom of the line.

values.name: SPACING_MAX
values.description: Represents the size of the [enum SpacingType] enum.

values.name: FONT_BOLD
values.description: Font is bold.

values.name: FONT_ITALIC
values.description: Font is italic or oblique.

values.name: FONT_FIXED_WIDTH
values.description: Font has fixed-width characters (also known as monospace).

values.name: STRUCTURED_TEXT_DEFAULT
values.description: Use default Unicode BiDi algorithm.

values.name: STRUCTURED_TEXT_URI
values.description: BiDi override for URI.

values.name: STRUCTURED_TEXT_FILE
values.description: BiDi override for file path.

values.name: STRUCTURED_TEXT_EMAIL
values.description: BiDi override for email.

values.name: STRUCTURED_TEXT_LIST
values.description: BiDi override for lists. Structured text options: list separator [String].

values.name: STRUCTURED_TEXT_GDSCRIPT
values.description: BiDi override for GDScript.

values.name: STRUCTURED_TEXT_CUSTOM
values.description: User defined structured text BiDi override function.

values.name: FIXED_SIZE_SCALE_DISABLE
values.description: Bitmap font is not scaled.

values.name: FIXED_SIZE_SCALE_INTEGER_ONLY
values.description: Bitmap font is scaled to the closest integer multiple of the font's fixed size. This is the recommended option for pixel art fonts.

values.name: FIXED_SIZE_SCALE_ENABLED
values.description: Bitmap font is scaled to an arbitrary (fractional) size. This is the recommended option for non-pixel art fonts.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the server supports a feature.

methods.name: get_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the server interface.

methods.name: get_features
methods.description: Returns text server features, see [enum Feature].

methods.name: load_support_data
methods.description:
Loads optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).
[b]Note:[/b] This function should be called before any other TextServer functions used, otherwise it won't have any effect.

methods.name: get_support_data_filename
methods.description: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) filename.

methods.name: get_support_data_info
methods.description: Returns TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) description.

methods.name: save_support_data
methods.description:
Saves optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) to the file.
[b]Note:[/b] This function is used by during project export, to include TextServer database.

methods.name: get_support_data
methods.description: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).

methods.name: is_locale_using_support_data
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the locale requires text server support data for line/word breaking.

methods.name: is_locale_right_to_left
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if locale is right-to-left.

methods.name: name_to_tag
methods.description: Converts the given readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language to an OpenType tag.

methods.name: tag_to_name
methods.description: Converts the given OpenType tag to the readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param rid] is valid resource owned by this text server.

methods.name: free_rid
methods.description: Frees an object created by this [TextServer].

methods.name: create_font
methods.description: Creates a new, empty font cache entry resource. To free the resulting resource, use the [method free_rid] method.

methods.name: create_font_linked_variation
methods.description: Creates a new variation existing font which is reusing the same glyph cache and font data. To free the resulting resource, use the [method free_rid] method.

methods.name: font_set_data
methods.description: Sets font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.

methods.name: font_set_face_index
methods.description: Sets an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

methods.name: font_get_face_index
methods.description: Returns an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

methods.name: font_get_face_count
methods.description: Returns number of faces in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

methods.name: font_set_style
methods.description:
Sets the font style flags.
[b]Note:[/b] This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use [method font_set_face_index], [method font_set_variation_coordinates], [method font_set_embolden], or [method font_set_transform] instead.

methods.name: font_get_style
methods.description: Returns font style flags.

methods.name: font_set_name
methods.description: Sets the font family name.

methods.name: font_get_name
methods.description: Returns font family name.

methods.name: font_get_ot_name_strings
methods.description: Returns [Dictionary] with OpenType font name strings (localized font names, version, description, license information, sample text, etc.).

methods.name: font_set_style_name
methods.description: Sets the font style name.

methods.name: font_get_style_name
methods.description: Returns font style name.

methods.name: font_set_weight
methods.description:
Sets weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the [code]100...999[/code] range, normal font weight is [code]400[/code], bold font weight is [code]700[/code].
[b]Note:[/b] This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use [method font_set_face_index], [method font_set_variation_coordinates], or [method font_set_embolden] instead.

methods.name: font_get_weight
methods.description: Returns weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the [code]100...999[/code] range, normal font weight is [code]400[/code], bold font weight is [code]700[/code].

methods.name: font_set_stretch
methods.description:
Sets font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between [code]50%[/code] and [code]200%[/code].
[b]Note:[/b] This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use [method font_set_face_index], [method font_set_variation_coordinates], or [method font_set_transform] instead.

methods.name: font_get_stretch
methods.description: Returns font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between [code]50%[/code] and [code]200%[/code].

methods.name: font_set_antialiasing
methods.description: Sets font anti-aliasing mode.

methods.name: font_get_antialiasing
methods.description: Returns font anti-aliasing mode.

methods.name: font_set_disable_embedded_bitmaps
methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], embedded font bitmap loading is disabled (bitmap-only and color fonts ignore this property).

methods.name: font_get_disable_embedded_bitmaps
methods.description: Returns whether the font's embedded bitmap loading is disabled.

methods.name: font_set_generate_mipmaps
methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code] font texture mipmap generation is enabled.

methods.name: font_get_generate_mipmaps
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if font texture mipmap generation is enabled.

methods.name: font_set_multichannel_signed_distance_field
methods.description:
If set to [code]true[/code], glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data. MSDF rendering allows displaying the font at any scaling factor without blurriness, and without incurring a CPU cost when the font size changes (since the font no longer needs to be rasterized on the CPU). As a downside, font hinting is not available with MSDF. The lack of font hinting may result in less crisp and less readable fonts at small sizes.
[b]Note:[/b] MSDF font rendering does not render glyphs with overlapping shapes correctly. Overlapping shapes are not valid per the OpenType standard, but are still commonly found in many font files, especially those converted by Google Fonts. To avoid issues with overlapping glyphs, consider downloading the font file directly from the type foundry instead of relying on Google Fonts.

methods.name: font_is_multichannel_signed_distance_field
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data.

methods.name: font_set_msdf_pixel_range
methods.description: Sets the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.

methods.name: font_get_msdf_pixel_range
methods.description: Returns the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.

methods.name: font_set_msdf_size
methods.description: Sets source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

methods.name: font_get_msdf_size
methods.description: Returns source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

methods.name: font_set_fixed_size
methods.description: Sets bitmap font fixed size. If set to value greater than zero, same cache entry will be used for all font sizes.

methods.name: font_get_fixed_size
methods.description: Returns bitmap font fixed size.

methods.name: font_set_fixed_size_scale_mode
methods.description: Sets bitmap font scaling mode. This property is used only if [code]fixed_size[/code] is greater than zero.

methods.name: font_get_fixed_size_scale_mode
methods.description: Returns bitmap font scaling mode.

methods.name: font_set_allow_system_fallback
methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

methods.name: font_is_allow_system_fallback
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

methods.name: font_clear_system_fallback_cache
methods.description: Frees all automatically loaded system fonts.

methods.name: font_set_force_autohinter
methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code] auto-hinting is preferred over font built-in hinting.

methods.name: font_is_force_autohinter
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font built-in hinting. Used by dynamic fonts only.

methods.name: font_set_modulate_color_glyphs
methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs, otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.

methods.name: font_is_modulate_color_glyphs
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if color modulation is applied when drawing the font's colored glyphs.

methods.name: font_get_palette_count
methods.description: Returns the number of predefined color palettes. Palette contains all colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the same number of colors.

methods.name: font_get_palette_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the predefined color palette at [param index]. Palette contains all colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the same number of colors.

methods.name: font_get_palette_colors
methods.description: Returns the array in the predefined color palette at [param index]. Palette contains all colors used to render font glyphs. Each palette has the same number of colors. Colors can be overridden using [method font_set_palette_custom_colors].

methods.name: font_set_palette_custom_colors
methods.description: Sets array of custom colors to override predefined palette. Set to empty array to reset overrides. Use [code]Color(0, 0, 0, 0)[/code], to keep predefined palette color at specific position.

methods.name: font_get_palette_custom_colors
methods.description: Returns array of custom colors to override predefined palette.

methods.name: font_get_used_palette
methods.description: Returns used palette index.

methods.name: font_set_used_palette
methods.description: Sets used palette index.

methods.name: font_set_hinting
methods.description: Sets font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.

methods.name: font_get_hinting
methods.description: Returns the font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.

methods.name: font_set_subpixel_positioning
methods.description: Sets font subpixel glyph positioning mode.

methods.name: font_get_subpixel_positioning
methods.description: Returns font subpixel glyph positioning mode.

methods.name: font_set_keep_rounding_remainders
methods.description: Sets glyph position rounding behavior. If set to [code]true[/code], when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.

methods.name: font_get_keep_rounding_remainders
methods.description: Returns glyph position rounding behavior. If set to [code]true[/code], when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.

methods.name: font_set_embolden
methods.description: Sets font embolden strength. If [param strength] is not equal to zero, emboldens the font outlines. Negative values reduce the outline thickness.

methods.name: font_get_embolden
methods.description: Returns font embolden strength.

methods.name: font_set_spacing
methods.description: Sets the spacing for [param spacing] to [param value] in pixels (not relative to the font size).

methods.name: font_get_spacing
methods.description: Returns the spacing for [param spacing] in pixels (not relative to the font size).

methods.name: font_set_baseline_offset
methods.description: Sets extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).

methods.name: font_get_baseline_offset
methods.description: Returns extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).

methods.name: font_set_transform
methods.description:
Sets 2D transform, applied to the font outlines, can be used for slanting, flipping, and rotating glyphs.
For example, to simulate italic typeface by slanting, apply the following transform [code]Transform2D(1.0, slant, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0)[/code].

methods.name: font_get_transform
methods.description: Returns 2D transform applied to the font outlines.

methods.name: font_set_variation_coordinates
methods.description: Sets variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See [method font_supported_variation_list] for more info.

methods.name: font_get_variation_coordinates
methods.description: Returns variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See [method font_supported_variation_list] for more info.

methods.name: font_set_oversampling

methods.name: font_get_glyph_contours
methods.description:
Returns outline contours of the glyph as a [Dictionary] with the following contents:
[code]points[/code]         - [PackedVector3Array], containing outline points. [code]x[/code] and [code]y[/code] are point coordinates. [code]z[/code] is the type of the point, using the [enum ContourPointTag] values.
[code]contours[/code]       - [PackedInt32Array], containing indices the end points of each contour.
[code]orientation[/code]    - [bool], contour orientation. If [code]true[/code], clockwise contours must be filled.
- Two successive [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] points indicate a line segment.
- One [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CONIC] point between two [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] points indicates a single conic (quadratic) Bézier arc.
- Two [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CUBIC] points between two [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] points indicate a single cubic Bézier arc.
- Two successive [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CONIC] points indicate two successive conic (quadratic) Bézier arcs with a virtual [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_ON] point at their middle.
- Each contour is closed. The last point of a contour uses the first point of a contour as its next point, and vice versa. The first point can be [constant CONTOUR_CURVE_TAG_OFF_CONIC] point.

methods.name: shaped_text_draw
methods.description:
Draw shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
[param clip_l] and [param clip_r] are offsets relative to [param pos], going to the right in horizontal layout and downward in vertical layout. If [param clip_l] is not negative, glyphs starting before the offset are clipped. If [param clip_r] is not negative, glyphs ending after the offset are clipped.

methods.name: shaped_text_draw_outline
methods.description:
Draw the outline of the shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with [param color]. [param pos] specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If [param oversampling] is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
[param clip_l] and [param clip_r] are offsets relative to [param pos], going to the right in horizontal layout and downward in vertical layout. If [param clip_l] is not negative, glyphs starting before the offset are clipped. If [param clip_r] is not negative, glyphs ending after the offset are clipped.

methods.name: string_get_word_breaks
methods.description:
Returns an array of the word break boundaries. Elements in the returned array are the offsets of the start and end of words. Therefore the length of the array is always even.
When [param chars_per_line] is greater than zero, line break boundaries are returned instead.
[codeblock]
var ts = TextServerManager.get_primary_interface()
# Corresponds to the substrings "The", "Godot", "Engine", and "4".
print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4")) # Prints [0, 3, 4, 9, 10, 16, 18, 19]
# Corresponds to the substrings "The", "Godot", "Engin", and "e, 4".
print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4", "en", 5)) # Prints [0, 3, 4, 9, 10, 15, 15, 19]
# Corresponds to the substrings "The Godot" and "Engine, 4".
print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4", "en", 10)) # Prints [0, 9, 10, 19]
[/codeblock]

methods.name: string_get_character_breaks
methods.description:
Returns array of the composite character boundaries.
[codeblock]
var ts = TextServerManager.get_primary_interface()
print(ts.string_get_character_breaks("Test ❤️‍🔥 Test")) # Prints [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]
[/codeblock]

Returns index of the first string in [param dict] which is visually confusable with the [param string], or [code]-1[/code] if none is found.
[b]Note:[/b] This method doesn't detect invisible characters, for spoof detection use it in combination with [method spoof_check].
[b]Note:[/b] Always returns [code]-1[/code] if the server does not support the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_SECURITY] feature.

[b]Note:[/b] Always returns [code]false[/code] if the server does not support the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_SECURITY] feature.

methods.name: strip_diacritics
methods.description:
Strips diacritics from the string.
[b]Note:[/b] The result may be longer or shorter than the original.

methods.name: is_valid_identifier
methods.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if [param string] is a valid identifier.
If the text server supports the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_IDENTIFIERS] feature, a valid identifier must:
- Conform to normalization form C.
- Begin with a Unicode character of class XID_Start or [code]"_"[/code].
- May contain Unicode characters of class XID_Continue in the other positions.
- Use UAX #31 recommended scripts only (mixed scripts are allowed).
If the [constant FEATURE_UNICODE_IDENTIFIERS] feature is not supported, a valid identifier must:
- Begin with a Unicode character of class XID_Start or [code]"_"[/code].
- May contain Unicode characters of class XID_Continue in the other positions.

methods.name: is_valid_letter
methods.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the given code point is a valid letter, i.e. it belongs to the Unicode category "L".

methods.name: string_to_upper

Returns the string converted to [code]UPPERCASE[/code].
[b]Note:[/b] Casing is locale dependent and context sensitive if server support [constant FEATURE_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE_CASE_CONVERSION] feature (supported by [TextServerAdvanced]).
[b]Note:[/b] The result may be longer or shorter than the original.

methods.name: string_to_lower

classes.brief_description: A server interface for font management and text rendering.
classes.description:
[TextServer] is the API backend for managing fonts and rendering text.
[b]Note:[/b] This is a low-level API, consider using [TextLine], [TextParagraph], and [Font] classes instead.
This is an abstract class, so to get the currently active [TextServer] instance, use the following code:
[codeblocks]
[gdscript]
var ts = TextServerManager.get_primary_interface()
[/gdscript]
[csharp]
var ts = TextServerManager.GetPrimaryInterface();
[/csharp]
[/codeblocks]

classes.name: TextServerAdvanced
classes.brief_description: An advanced text server with support for BiDi, complex text layout, and contextual OpenType features. Used in Godot by default.
classes.description: An implementation of [TextServer] that uses HarfBuzz, ICU and SIL Graphite to support BiDi, complex text layouts and contextual OpenType features. This is Godot's default primary [TextServer] interface.

methods.description: If set to [code]true[/code], glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data. MSDF rendering allows displaying the font at any scaling factor without blurriness, and without incurring a CPU cost when the font size changes (since the font no longer needs to be rasterized on the CPU). As a downside, font hinting is not available with MSDF. The lack of font hinting may result in less crisp and less readable fonts at small sizes.

classes.brief_description: Texture for 2D and 3D.
classes.description:
A texture works by registering an image in the video hardware, which then can be used in 3D models or 2D [Sprite2D] or GUI [Control].
Textures are often created by loading them from a file. See [method @GDScript.load].
[Texture2D] is a base for other resources. It cannot be used directly.
[b]Note:[/b] The maximum texture size is 16384×16384 pixels due to graphics hardware limitations. Larger textures may fail to import.

classes.name: Texture2DArray

methods.name: create_placeholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder version of this resource ([PlaceholderTexture2DArray]).

classes.brief_description: A single texture resource which consists of multiple, separate images. Each image has the same dimensions and number of mipmap levels.
classes.description:
A Texture2DArray is different from a Texture3D: The Texture2DArray does not support trilinear interpolation between the [Image]s, i.e. no blending. See also [Cubemap] and [CubemapArray], which are texture arrays with specialized cubemap functions.
A Texture2DArray is also different from an [AtlasTexture]: In a Texture2DArray, all images are treated separately. In an atlas, the regions (i.e. the single images) can be of different sizes. Furthermore, you usually need to add a padding around the regions, to prevent accidental UV mapping to more than one region. The same goes for mipmapping: Mipmap chains are handled separately for each layer. In an atlas, the slicing has to be done manually in the fragment shader.
To create such a texture file yourself, reimport your image files using the Godot Editor import presets. To create a Texture2DArray from code, use [method ImageTextureLayered.create_from_images] on an instance of the Texture2DArray class.

This texture array class allows you to use a 2D array texture created directly on the [RenderingDevice] as a texture for materials, meshes, etc.
[b]Note:[/b] [Texture2DArrayRD] is intended for low-level usage with [RenderingDevice]. For most use cases, use [Texture2DArray] instead.

properties.name: texture_normal
properties.description: Texture to display by default, when the node is [b]not[/b] in the disabled, hover or pressed state. This texture is still displayed in the focused state, with [member texture_focused] drawn on top.

properties.name: texture_pressed
properties.description: Texture to display on mouse down over the node, if the node has keyboard focus and the player presses the Enter key or if the player presses the [member BaseButton.shortcut] key. If not assigned, the [TextureButton] displays [member texture_hover] instead when pressed.

properties.description: Texture to display when the mouse hovers over the node. If not assigned, the [TextureButton] displays [member texture_normal] instead when hovered over.

properties.name: texture_disabled

properties.name: texture_focused
properties.description: Texture to [i]overlay on the base texture[/i] when the node has mouse or keyboard focus. Because [member texture_focused] is displayed on top of the base texture, a partially transparent texture should be used to ensure the base texture remains visible. A texture that represents an outline or an underline works well for this purpose. To disable the focus visual effect, assign a fully transparent texture of any size. Note that disabling the focus visual effect will harm keyboard/controller navigation usability, so this is not recommended for accessibility reasons.

properties.name: texture_click_mask

properties.name: flip_h

properties.name: flip_v

classes.brief_description: Texture-based button. Supports Pressed, Hover, Disabled and Focused states.
classes.description:
[TextureButton] has the same functionality as [Button], except it uses sprites instead of Godot's [Theme] resource. It is faster to create, but it doesn't support localization like more complex [Control]s.
See also [BaseButton] which contains common properties and methods associated with this node.
[b]Note:[/b] Setting a texture for the "normal" state ([member texture_normal]) is recommended. If [member texture_normal] is not set, the [TextureButton] will still receive input events and be clickable, but the user will not be able to see it unless they activate another one of its states with a texture assigned (e.g., hover over it to show [member texture_hover]).

properties.description:
Upper limit for the fill of [member texture_progress] if [member fill_mode] is [constant FILL_CLOCKWISE], [constant FILL_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE], or [constant FILL_CLOCKWISE_AND_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE]. When the node's [code]value[/code] is equal to its [code]max_value[/code], the texture fills up to this angle.
See [member Range.value], [member Range.max_value].

properties.name: radial_center_offset
properties.description:
Offsets [member texture_progress] if [member fill_mode] is [constant FILL_CLOCKWISE], [constant FILL_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE], or [constant FILL_CLOCKWISE_AND_COUNTER_CLOCKWISE].
[b]Note:[/b] The effective radial center always stays within the [member texture_progress] bounds. If you need to move it outside the texture's bounds, modify the [member texture_progress] to contain additional empty space where needed.

properties.name: nine_patch_stretch
properties.description: If [code]true[/code], Godot treats the bar's textures like in [NinePatchRect]. Use the [code]stretch_margin_*[/code] properties like [member stretch_margin_bottom] to set up the nine patch's 3×3 grid. When using a radial [member fill_mode], this setting will only enable stretching for [member texture_progress], while [member texture_under] and [member texture_over] will be treated like in [NinePatchRect].

properties.name: stretch_margin_left
properties.description: The width of the 9-patch's left column. Only effective if [member nine_patch_stretch] is [code]true[/code].

properties.name: stretch_margin_top
properties.description: The height of the 9-patch's top row. Only effective if [member nine_patch_stretch] is [code]true[/code].

properties.name: stretch_margin_right
properties.description: The width of the 9-patch's right column. Only effective if [member nine_patch_stretch] is [code]true[/code].

properties.name: stretch_margin_bottom
properties.description: The height of the 9-patch's bottom row. A margin of 16 means the 9-slice's bottom corners and side will have a height of 16 pixels. You can set all 4 margin values individually to create panels with non-uniform borders. Only effective if [member nine_patch_stretch] is [code]true[/code].

properties.name: texture_under
properties.description: [Texture2D] that draws under the progress bar. The bar's background.

properties.name: texture_over
properties.description: [Texture2D] that draws over the progress bar. Use it to add highlights or an upper-frame that hides part of [member texture_progress].

properties.name: texture_progress
properties.description:
[Texture2D] that clips based on the node's [code]value[/code] and [member fill_mode]. As [code]value[/code] increased, the texture fills up. It shows entirely when [code]value[/code] reaches [code]max_value[/code]. It doesn't show at all if [code]value[/code] is equal to [code]min_value[/code].
The [code]value[/code] property comes from [Range]. See [member Range.value], [member Range.min_value], [member Range.max_value].

properties.name: texture_progress_offset
properties.description: The offset of [member texture_progress]. Useful for [member texture_over] and [member texture_under] with fancy borders, to avoid transparent margins in your progress texture.

properties.name: tint_under
properties.description: Multiplies the color of the bar's [member texture_under] texture.

properties.name: tint_over
properties.description: Multiplies the color of the bar's [member texture_over] texture. The effect is similar to [member CanvasItem.modulate], except it only affects this specific texture instead of the entire node.

properties.name: tint_progress
properties.description: Multiplies the color of the bar's [member texture_progress] texture.

values.name: EXPAND_KEEP_SIZE

values.name: EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE

values.name: EXPAND_FIT_WIDTH
values.description: The height of the texture will be ignored. Minimum width will be equal to the current height. Useful for horizontal layouts, e.g. inside [HBoxContainer].

values.name: EXPAND_FIT_HEIGHT_PROPORTIONAL

values.name: STRETCH_SCALE

values.name: STRETCH_TILE
values.description:
Tile inside the node's bounding rectangle.
